	Cross-file: Update / UpdateModel must integrate SpeedMultiplier + _spinRate each frame.
]]

local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local EventsCollision = {}

-- Pre-bounce vMag (studs/sec) gate. Below this engages _settleEngaged + scales
-- bounce-spin damping toward zero (rolling-friction proxy).
local REST_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD = 1.0

-- Restitution clamp (Jolt mMinVelocityForRestitution / Box2D b2_velocityThreshold).
-- Below this, e := 0  -  inelastic. Breaks Zeno micro-bouncing.
local MIN_REST_VELOCITY = 0.5

-- Point-velocity (linear + |spinRate|·radius) below this advances _restTimer.
-- Jolt mPointVelocitySleepThreshold = 0.03 m/s, scaled to stud units.
local SLEEP_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD = 0.1

-- Rest-timer threshold for permanent freeze. Matches Box2D + Jolt 0.5s default.
local TIME_BEFORE_SLEEP = 0.5

-- Angular damping (1/sec) on _spinRate while settling. Half-life ≈ 0.116s.
local ANGULAR_REST_DRAG = 6.0

-- Damp authored RotSpeedX/Y/Z graph contribution to zero during settle. Without
-- this, settled body keeps rotating from RotMode=OverLife / RotMode=Speed grids.
local ROT_GRAPH_DAMP = 6.0

-- Per-particle ±range jitter (width fraction; 0.4 = ±20%) on bounce + settle
-- params. Decorrelates same-burst particles so bounce count + settle time
-- vary naturally instead of all particles converging in lockstep.
local BOUNCINESS_JITTER_RANGE = 0.4
local FRICTION_JITTER_RANGE = 0.4
local REST_CLAMP_JITTER_RANGE = 0.4
local SLEEP_TIME_JITTER_RANGE = 0.4

-- Gravity-torque gain: τ = sin(tilt)·|g|·GAIN. 0.5 → ~70 deg/sec² at 45° + default gravity.
local TIPPING_GAIN = 0.5

-- Permanent-freeze thresholds (both must hold): spin deg/sec, tilt radians.
local SPIN_FREEZE_EPSILON = 0.5
local ANGLE_FREEZE_EPSILON = 0.02

-- Body-local axes scanned for face-down orientation (the six box faces).
local _BODY_AXES = {
	Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
	Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
}

-- Hit history for negative-Timescale reverse. Newest-keep ring: reverse playback
-- always crosses recent hits first, so dropping the oldest preserves rewind
-- fidelity for the most recent HIT_HISTORY_CAP collisions.
local HIT_HISTORY_CAP = 16

local function _snapshotPData(pData, kind)
	return {
		time = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0,
		kind = kind,
		BaseDirection = pData.BaseDirection,
		SpeedMultiplier = pData.SpeedMultiplier,
		_accelVel = pData._accelVel,
		TargetVel = pData.TargetVel,
		_spinRate = pData._spinRate,
		_spinAccumX = pData._spinAccumX,
		_spinAccumY = pData._spinAccumY,
		_spinAccumZ = pData._spinAccumZ,
		AccRotX = pData.AccRotX,
		AccRotY = pData.AccRotY,
		AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ,
		LocalCF = pData.LocalCF,
		_localWorldCF = pData._localWorldCF,
		CurrentPosition = pData.CurrentPosition,
		_hitFired = pData._hitFired,
		LastHitCheckPos = pData.LastHitCheckPos,
		_collisionStopped = pData._collisionStopped,
		CurrentStep = pData.CurrentStep,
		AccumulatedDT = pData.AccumulatedDT,
		-- PosOffset bounce reflection: mirror axes (nil pre-first-bounce) + the
		-- delta-accumulation baseline _prevWorldOff. Both flip on Bounce; both must
		-- restore on reverse-Timescale rewind across the hit boundary.
		_displacementMirrorX = pData._displacementMirrorX,
		_displacementMirrorY = pData._displacementMirrorY,
		_displacementMirrorZ = pData._displacementMirrorZ,
		_prevWorldOff = pData._prevWorldOff,
		_prevTurbOff = pData._prevTurbOff,
		-- Settle state flag + rest-timer accumulator (Box2D/Jolt sleep pattern).
		-- Both restore on reverse-Timescale rewind so the body un-settles cleanly.
		_settleEngaged = pData._settleEngaged,
		_restTimer = pData._restTimer,
		_settleRotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp,
		_settleContactPos = pData._settleContactPos,
		_settleSpawnHalf = pData._settleSpawnHalf,
		-- Last surface normal  -  gravity-torque target reference for tip math.
		_lastHitNormal = pData._lastHitNormal,
	}
end

local function _pushHit(pData, snap)
	pData._hitHistory = pData._hitHistory or {}
	-- Drop oldest when full so the newest hit is always recorded.
	if #pData._hitHistory >= HIT_HISTORY_CAP then
		table.remove(pData._hitHistory, 1)
	end
	table.insert(pData._hitHistory, snap)
end

-- Called by Update when dt < 0; iterates back-to-front so earliest crossed hit wins.
function EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	local history = pData._hitHistory
	if not history then return end
	for i = #history, 1, -1 do
		local h = history[i]
		if h.time > newEff and h.time <= priorEff then
			pData.BaseDirection = h.BaseDirection
			pData.SpeedMultiplier = h.SpeedMultiplier
			pData._accelVel = h._accelVel
			pData.TargetVel = h.TargetVel
			pData._spinRate = h._spinRate
			pData._spinAccumX = h._spinAccumX
			pData._spinAccumY = h._spinAccumY
			pData._spinAccumZ = h._spinAccumZ
			pData.AccRotX = h.AccRotX
			pData.AccRotY = h.AccRotY
			pData.AccRotZ = h.AccRotZ
			pData.LocalCF = h.LocalCF
			pData._localWorldCF = h._localWorldCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = h.CurrentPosition
			pData._hitFired = h._hitFired
			pData.LastHitCheckPos = h.LastHitCheckPos
			pData._collisionStopped = h._collisionStopped
			pData.CurrentStep = h.CurrentStep
			pData.AccumulatedDT = h.AccumulatedDT
			pData._displacementMirrorX = h._displacementMirrorX
			pData._displacementMirrorY = h._displacementMirrorY
			pData._displacementMirrorZ = h._displacementMirrorZ
			pData._prevWorldOff = h._prevWorldOff
			pData._prevTurbOff = h._prevTurbOff
			pData._settleEngaged = h._settleEngaged
			pData._restTimer = h._restTimer
			pData._settleRotDamp = h._settleRotDamp
			pData._settleContactPos = h._settleContactPos
			pData._settleSpawnHalf = h._settleSpawnHalf
			pData._lastHitNormal = h._lastHitNormal
			table.remove(history, i)
		end
	end
end

-- Per-type write: BasePart .CFrame, Model :PivotTo, Attachment world→parent-local.
local function applySnapCFrame(pData, snapCF)
	local v = pData.VisualPart
	if not v or not v.Parent then return end
	if pData.Type == "Model" then v:PivotTo(snapCF); return end
	if pData.Type == "Attachment" then
		local parent = v.Parent
		v.CFrame = (parent and parent:IsA("BasePart")) and parent.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(snapCF) or snapCF
		return
	end
	v.CFrame = snapCF
end

-- World CFrame read: Model = pivot, Attachment = parent*local.
local function readWorldCF(pData)
	local v = pData.VisualPart
	if not v or not v.Parent then return CFrame.new() end
	if pData.Type == "Model" then return v:GetPivot() end
	if pData.Type == "Attachment" then
		local p = v.Parent
		return (p and p:IsA("BasePart")) and (p.CFrame * v.CFrame) or v.CFrame
	end
	return v.CFrame
end

-- Parent-link world CFrame for Part/Model bounce LocalCF rebuild.
-- RigidLocal reads the at-emit snapshot so bounce reflections stay in the frozen frame.
local function bounceParentCF(pData)
	return (LinkCF.parentFrame(pData))
end

-- Attachment LocalCF lives in parentCF_now (actualParent-local); convert snap via actualParent first.
local function attachmentBounceLocalPos(pData, snapPos)
	local visualAtt = pData.VisualPart
	local actualParent = visualAtt and visualAtt.Parent
	local convCF = (actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart")) and actualParent.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	local parentCF_now = (LinkCF.attachmentParentFrame(pData))
	local snapInActualParent = convCF:PointToObjectSpace(snapPos)
	return parentCF_now:PointToObjectSpace(snapInActualParent)
end

-- Snap to hit.Position keeping current rotation. Kill = destroy. Stop = freeze + age out.
-- Stop snapshots pData first for reverse-Timescale restore; Kill doesn't.
local function handleKillOrStop(particle, pData, hit, mode)
	local stopSnap = (mode ~= "Kill") and _snapshotPData(pData, "Stop") or nil
	local existing = readWorldCF(pData)
	local snapCF = CFrame.new(hit.Position) * (existing - existing.Position)
	applySnapCFrame(pData, snapCF)
	pData.CurrentPosition = hit.Position
	if mode == "Kill" then
		if particle._killParticle then
			particle:_killParticle(pData, { fireOnDeath = true })
		end
	else
		-- Sync companion CFrame caches with the snap so next Heartbeat's ReapplyLink (LinkTrack)
		-- and ApplyOrientation (Orientation) reads don't pull the particle back to pre-stop pos.
		if pData.LocalCF then
			local localPos
			if pData.Type == "Attachment" then
				localPos = attachmentBounceLocalPos(pData, hit.Position)
			else
				localPos = bounceParentCF(pData):PointToObjectSpace(hit.Position)
			end
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(localPos) * (pData.LocalCF - pData.LocalCF.Position)
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF
		end
		pData._postUpdateCF = snapCF
		pData._collisionStopped = true
		pData.LastHitCheckPos = hit.Position
		pData._hitFired = true
		if stopSnap then _pushHit(pData, stopSnap) end
	end
end

-- Split V into normal+tangent, restitute (-e*V_n), damp ((1-μ)*V_t). Magnitude folds into
-- SpeedMultiplier (BaseDirection stays unit). _accelVel + TargetVel are absolute, no rescale.
local function handleBounce(pData, hit, dir, segmentDT)
	local nrm = hit.Normal
	local oh = pData.Events.OnHit
	-- Lazy-init per-particle jitter on first bounce. Decorrelates same-burst particles
	-- so bounce count + settle time spread naturally instead of converging in lockstep.
	pData._bouncinessJitter = pData._bouncinessJitter or (1 + (math.random() - 0.5) * BOUNCINESS_JITTER_RANGE)
	pData._frictionJitter = pData._frictionJitter or (1 + (math.random() - 0.5) * FRICTION_JITTER_RANGE)
	pData._restClampJitter = pData._restClampJitter or (1 + (math.random() - 0.5) * REST_CLAMP_JITTER_RANGE)
	pData._sleepTimeJitter = pData._sleepTimeJitter or (1 + (math.random() - 0.5) * SLEEP_TIME_JITTER_RANGE)
	local e = (oh.Bounciness or 0.7) * pData._bouncinessJitter
	local mu = (oh.Friction or 0.2) * pData._frictionJitter
	local spinCoef = oh.Spin or 0.5
	if not segmentDT or segmentDT <= 0 then segmentDT = 1/60 end

	-- Snapshot pre-mutation for reverse-Timescale; pushed at function exit.
	local hitSnap = _snapshotPData(pData, "Bounce")

	-- Surface normal for applySettle's gravity-torque tip target. Most-recent wins.
	pData._lastHitNormal = nrm

	-- Restitution clamp (Jolt/Box2D pattern): below threshold, force inelastic
	-- (e=0) so low-velocity contacts can't trigger infinite micro-bounces.
	local v_normal_speed = math.abs((dir / segmentDT):Dot(nrm))
	local e_eff = e
	if v_normal_speed < MIN_REST_VELOCITY * (pData._restClampJitter or 1) then e_eff = 0 end

	local bd = pData.BaseDirection
	if bd then
		local bdN = bd:Dot(nrm) * nrm
		local bdT = bd - bdN
		local bdPost = -e_eff * bdN + (1 - mu) * bdT
		local mag = bdPost.Magnitude
		if mag > 1e-4 then
			pData.BaseDirection = bdPost.Unit
			pData.SpeedMultiplier = (pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1) * mag
		else
			-- bdPost ≈ 0 (e=0 perpendicular hit): stall linear motion; accel can still lift.
			pData.SpeedMultiplier = 0
		end
	end

	local av = pData._accelVel
	if av then
		local aN = av:Dot(nrm) * nrm
		local aT = av - aN
		pData._accelVel = -e_eff * aN + (1 - mu) * aT
	end

	local tv = pData.TargetVel
	if tv then
		local tN = tv:Dot(nrm) * nrm
		local tT = tv - tN
		pData.TargetVel = -e_eff * tN + (1 - mu) * tT
	end

	-- Angular kick from tangent velocity. Cross order nrm × v_t produces forward-roll
	-- (e.g. +X over +Y floor → -Z spin). restFactor scales damping toward 0 as
	-- pre-bounce speed approaches zero  -  rolling-friction proxy at rest.
	local existingSpin = pData._spinRate or Vector3.zero
	local v_t = (dir - dir:Dot(nrm) * nrm) / segmentDT
	local vMag = (dir / segmentDT).Magnitude
	local kick = Vector3.zero
	if v_t.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
		kick = nrm:Cross(v_t) * (spinCoef * 3.33)
	end
	local restFactor = math.min(1, vMag / REST_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD)
	pData._spinRate = existingSpin * (1 - mu) * restFactor + kick

	-- _settleEngaged sticks on first low-velocity bounce. Enables Coulomb contact
	-- constraint in PartConstants.applyContactAccel + gravity-torque tipping in
	-- applySettle. Cleared only by _clearSettleState (external mutator wake).
	if vMag < REST_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD then
		if not pData._settleEngaged then
			-- Cache surface contact point + initial half-extent so applySettle can
			-- keep the body's bottom face flush with the surface as Size shrinks
			-- (prevents floating-vanish when Size graph fades to 0).
			local visual = pData.VisualPart
			if visual and visual:IsA("BasePart") then
				local halfExtent = visual.Size.Magnitude * 0.5
				pData._settleSpawnHalf = halfExtent
				pData._settleContactPos = visual.Position - nrm * halfExtent
			end
		end
		pData._settleEngaged = true
	end

	-- PosOffset trajectory reflection: mirror each cached axis vector about hit.Normal
	-- so PosOffset-driven motion bounces off surfaces just like Speed-driven motion.
	-- Lazy-init at first bounce; nil mirror axes elsewhere skip the matrix-apply
	-- fast-path inside Constants.resolveDisplacement.
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local function _reflect(v) return v - 2 * v:Dot(nrm) * nrm end
		local mx = pData._displacementMirrorX or Vector3.xAxis
		local my = pData._displacementMirrorY or Vector3.yAxis
		local mz = pData._displacementMirrorZ or Vector3.zAxis
		pData._displacementMirrorX = _reflect(mx)
		pData._displacementMirrorY = _reflect(my)
		pData._displacementMirrorZ = _reflect(mz)
		-- Re-baseline _prevWorldOff under the new mirror so the next per-frame delta
		-- (newWorldOff - _prevWorldOff) doesn't snap. Sample current PosOffset graphs
		-- and apply the freshly-updated mirror.
		local steppedI = (pData.CurrentStep or 0) / math.max(pData.TotalKeyFrames, 1)
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		pData._prevWorldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
			pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
	end

	-- Offset along normal so next ray doesn't re-hit the same face.
	local snapPos = hit.Position + nrm * 0.05
	-- LocalCF position only; rotation gets re-composed on top by UpdatePart.
	if pData.LocalCF then
		local localPos
		if pData.Type == "Attachment" then
			localPos = attachmentBounceLocalPos(pData, snapPos)
		else
			localPos = bounceParentCF(pData):PointToObjectSpace(snapPos)
		end
		pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(localPos) * (pData.LocalCF - pData.LocalCF.Position)
		pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF
	end
	local existing = readWorldCF(pData)
	local snapCF = CFrame.new(snapPos) * (existing - existing.Position)
	applySnapCFrame(pData, snapCF)
	-- Mirror of handleKillOrStop: keep _postUpdateCF in sync so unlinked-particle Orientation
	-- pass doesn't snap the visual back to its pre-bounce CFrame next Heartbeat.
	pData._postUpdateCF = snapCF
	pData.CurrentPosition = snapPos
	pData.LastHitCheckPos = snapPos
	pData._hitFired = false

	_pushHit(pData, hitSnap)
end

-- Per-frame settle pass: spin decay, gravity-torque tip (τ ∝ sin(tilt)·|g| about
-- worldDown × hitNormal), size-sink, Box2D/Jolt rest-timer freeze.
function EventsCollision.applySettle(pData, dt)
	if not pData or pData._collisionStopped then return end
	if not pData._settleEngaged then return end
	if pData.NeedsFullIteration then return end
	if dt and dt > 0 then
		local decay = math.exp(-ANGULAR_REST_DRAG * dt)
		pData._spinRate = (pData._spinRate or Vector3.zero) * decay
		-- Authored RotSpeed graph contribution decays to zero in parallel.
		-- Update.luau reads pData._settleRotDamp at every RotSpeed sample site.
		pData._settleRotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * math.exp(-ROT_GRAPH_DAMP * dt)
	end
	local nrm = pData._lastHitNormal
	if not nrm or nrm.Magnitude < 1e-4 then return end
	local visual = pData.VisualPart
	if not visual or not visual.Parent then return end

	local currentCF = readWorldCF(pData)
	local down = -nrm
	local bestAxis = _BODY_AXES[1]
	local bestDot = -math.huge
	for _, ax in ipairs(_BODY_AXES) do
		local worldAx = currentCF:VectorToWorldSpace(ax)
		local d = worldAx:Dot(down)
		if d > bestDot then
			bestDot = d
			bestAxis = ax
		end
	end
	local worldDownAxis = currentCF:VectorToWorldSpace(bestAxis)
	local tiltAngle = math.acos(math.clamp(worldDownAxis:Dot(down), -1, 1))
	local torqueAxisRaw = worldDownAxis:Cross(down)
	if torqueAxisRaw.Magnitude > 1e-4 and tiltAngle > 1e-4 and dt and dt > 0 then
		-- Authored Acceleration is the gravity source. Zero-gravity emitters skip tipping
		-- (no torque), matching physical intuition.
		local accelVec = pData.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
		local gravityMag = accelVec.Magnitude
		if gravityMag > 1 then
			local torqueMag = math.sin(tiltAngle) * gravityMag * TIPPING_GAIN
			local torqueVec = torqueAxisRaw.Unit * torqueMag
			pData._spinRate = (pData._spinRate or Vector3.zero) + torqueVec * dt
		end
	end

	-- Size-sink: re-anchor CFrame.Position so the bottom face stays flush with
	-- the surface as Size shrinks (Roblox centers Part rendering on .Position).
	if pData._settleContactPos and pData._settleSpawnHalf and visual:IsA("BasePart") then
		local currentHalf = visual.Size.Magnitude * 0.5
		local newPos = pData._settleContactPos + nrm * currentHalf
		applySnapCFrame(pData, CFrame.new(newPos) * (currentCF - currentCF.Position))
	end

	-- Rest-timer accumulator (Box2D/Jolt sleep pattern). Point-velocity samples the
	-- bbox edge so rotation-induced motion blocks sleep, not just CoM stillness.
	local r = pData._sleepRadius or 1.0
	local spinMag = (pData._spinRate or Vector3.zero).Magnitude
	local angularPointVel = spinMag * r * (math.pi / 180)
	local linMag = math.abs(pData.SpeedMultiplier or 0) + (pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero).Magnitude
	local v_eff = linMag + angularPointVel
	if v_eff < SLEEP_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD then
		pData._restTimer = (pData._restTimer or 0) + dt
	else
		pData._restTimer = 0
	end
	if (pData._restTimer or 0) >= TIME_BEFORE_SLEEP * (pData._sleepTimeJitter or 1)
		and tiltAngle < ANGLE_FREEZE_EPSILON then
		pData._collisionStopped = true
		pData._spinRate = Vector3.zero
		pData._accelVel = Vector3.zero
		pData.SpeedMultiplier = 0
		pData.TargetVel = Vector3.zero
	end
end

-- "snap" → caller returns immediately. "off" → caller updates LastHitCheckPos.
-- Bounce + InvertMotion downgrades to Kill (cached SimLocalCFrames can't reflect mid-flight).
-- Animate-mode VisualPart is the live source; Kill/Stop/Bounce would corrupt it, so they downgrade to Off.
function EventsCollision.handle(particle, pData, hit, dir, segmentDT)
	local mode = pData.Events.OnHit.Collision or "Off"
	if mode == "Bounce" and pData.InvertMotion then mode = "Kill" end
	if pData.IsAnimate and (mode == "Kill" or mode == "Stop" or mode == "Bounce") then
		mode = "Off"
	end

	if mode == "Kill" or mode == "Stop" then
		handleKillOrStop(particle, pData, hit, mode)
		return "snap"
	elseif mode == "Bounce" then
		handleBounce(pData, hit, dir, segmentDT)
		return "snap"
	end

	pData._hitFired = true
	return "off"
end

return EventsCollision

--[[
	EventsPayload  -  payload-builder + type-dispatched mutators bound to a fired event's payload.

	build(pData, eventName, emitCtx, cf)
	  Constructs the payload table the user's Module script receives. Per-event extras
	  (HitPosition / DeathPosition / EmitIndex / Age / LingerElapsed) are populated by
	  Events.fire / Events.afterUpdate after this call.

	apply* helpers (operate on pData directly; the payload.<Setter> closures wire to these):
	  applyColor          → visual.Color3 + pData.SkipColor=true
	  applyTransparency   → visual.Transparency + pData.SkipTransparency=true
	  applyTeleport       → visual.CFrame / :PivotTo + reset orientation / hit-check anchors
	  applyAddSpin        → pData._spinRate += vec (per-axis angular velocity)
	  applyAddImpulse     → pData._accelVel += vec (acceleration-velocity accumulator kick)
	  applyFreezeTime     → pData._frozen=on (suspends effective-elapsed advance)
	  applyPause          → applyFreezeTime(true) + auto-clear after seconds
	  applySetSize        → BasePart.Size / Model ScaleTo / ImageLabel UDim2
	  applySetVelocity    → BaseDirection (unit) + speed-override magnitude
	  applyResurrect      → clears _killedManually / _forceDead (undoes payload.Kill)

	attach* helpers (wire setter closures onto payload):
	  attachSkipSetters     → SetSkipColor / SetSkipTransparency / SetSkipSize
	  attachAdvancedSetters → AddSpin / AddImpulse / FreezeTime / Pause / SetSize / SetVelocity / Resurrect

	Convention: every Set* that mutates a graphed channel auto-flips the matching pData.Skip*
	so per-frame graph writes don't clobber the override on the next Heartbeat. SetSkip* expose
	manual control of the same gate without writing a value.
]]

local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)

local EventsPayload = {}

-- Construct a payload table for a fired event. Caller passes a precomputed `cf` (world CFrame
-- or nil for screen kinds) to avoid circular dependency on Events.getWorldCF. Includes:
--   • Source identity + visual aliases.
--   • Life-cycle state (LifeProgress, TimeRemaining, StartTime, LifeTime).
--   • Speed-related: SpeedMultiplier (raw scalar; user computes velocity via BaseDirection if needed).
--   • ChainDepth (0 for root events, increments per cross-emitter hop).
--   • EmitCount (burst-size for OnEmit; nil for other events).
--   • Per-event extras: EmitPosition, Age, DeathPosition, LingerElapsed.
function EventsPayload.build(pData, eventName, emitCtx, cf)
	local pos = cf and cf.Position or nil
	local now = os.clock()
	local elapsed = pData.StartTime and math.max(0, now - pData.StartTime) or 0
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime or 0
	local lifeProgress = (lifeTime > 0) and math.min(1, elapsed / lifeTime) or 0
	local timeRemaining = math.max(0, lifeTime - elapsed)
	local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1
	local p = {
		SourceItem      = pData._sourceItem,
		Source          = pData._sourceItem,
		Particle        = pData.VisualPart,
		RenderTemplate  = pData.VisualPart,
		WorldCFrame     = cf,
		WorldPosition   = pos,
		LifeProgress    = lifeProgress,
		TimeRemaining   = timeRemaining,
		StartTime       = pData.StartTime,
		LifeTime        = lifeTime,
		SpeedMultiplier = speedMult,
		ChainDepth      = pData.EventChainCtx and pData.EventChainCtx.Depth or 0,
		EmitCount       = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitCount,
		_eventName      = eventName,
	}
	if eventName == "OnEmit" then
		p.EmitPosition = pos
		p.EmitIndex = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitIndex
	elseif eventName == "OnDeath" then
		p.DeathPosition = pos
		-- Real wall-time age. Mid-life Kill reports < LifeTime; natural death equals it.
		if pData.StartTime then
			p.Age = math.max(0, now - pData.StartTime)
		else
			p.Age = pData.LifeTime
		end
	elseif eventName == "OnDestruction" then
		p.DeathPosition = pos
		-- Wall-time inside the linger window. PartLife=0 path has no linger so elapsed=0.
		if pData._lingerStartTime then
			p.LingerElapsed = math.max(0, now - pData._lingerStartTime)
		else
			p.LingerElapsed = 0
		end
	end
	return p
end

-- Color3 write per particle Type. Animatable color targets vary by kind:
-- Part/Model: BasePart.Color + SurfaceAppearance.Color (when present).
-- Beam: Color = ColorSequence.new(color)  -  beams take a sequence; collapse to a one-stop
--       sequence so the override sticks across the full beam length.
-- PointLight: Color (Color3 directly).
-- ImageLabel: ImageColor3.
-- Screen: ColorCorrection → TintColor; Atmosphere → Color. Blur/Bloom have no color.
function EventsPayload.applyColor(pData, color)
	if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then return end
	pData.SkipColor = true
	-- VisualPart-less types (CameraShake, Distortion) have no colour/transparency channel: no-op.
	local v = pData.VisualPart
	if not v or not v.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t == "Part" or t == "Model" then
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() v.Color = color end) end
		local sa = v.FindFirstChildOfClass and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
		if sa then pcall(function() sa.Color = color end) end
	elseif t == "Beam" or t == "TrailEmitter" or t == "BeamNative" then
		pcall(function() v.Color = ColorSequence.new(color) end)
	elseif t == "PointLight" then
		pcall(function() v.Color = color end)
	elseif t == "Highlight" then
		pcall(function() v.FillColor = color end)
		pcall(function() v.OutlineColor = color end)
	elseif t == "ImageLabel" then
		pcall(function() v.ImageColor3 = color end)
	elseif t == "Screen" then
		-- Kind strings come from ScreenEmit: "Blur" / "Bloom" / "CC" / "Atmosphere".
		if pData.Kind == "CC" then
			pcall(function() v.TintColor = color end)
		elseif pData.Kind == "Atmosphere" then
			pcall(function() v.Color = color end)
		end
	elseif t == "Lightning" or t == "Rocks" or t == "Rope" then
		-- Write every rig part; SkipColor keeps the graph writer from clobbering.
		local rig = pData._rig
		if rig then
			local n = rig.partCount or rig.chunkCap
			pcall(function()
				for i = 1, n do rig.parts[i].Color = color end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Scalar 0..1 transparency write per particle Type.
-- PointLight has no transparency; cache the authored Brightness on first call (via
-- _baseBrightness) and modulate as base * (1 - amount) so SetTransparency(1) snuffs the
-- light and SetTransparency(0) restores it. Without the snapshot, repeated calls would
-- compound the multiplicative attenuation.
-- Screen kinds without a transparency analog (Blur/Bloom/Atmosphere) are no-ops; the
-- SkipTransparency flag still flips so the user can use it as a trigger for other logic.
function EventsPayload.applyTransparency(pData, amount)
	if type(amount) ~= "number" then return end
	amount = math.max(0, math.min(1, amount))
	pData.SkipTransparency = true
	-- VisualPart-less types (CameraShake, Distortion) have no colour/transparency channel: no-op.
	local v = pData.VisualPart
	if not v or not v.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t == "Part" or t == "Model" then
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() v.Transparency = amount end) end
		local d = v.FindFirstChildOfClass and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
		if d then pcall(function() d.Transparency = amount end) end
	elseif t == "Beam" or t == "TrailEmitter" or t == "BeamNative" then
		pcall(function() v.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(amount) end)
	elseif t == "PointLight" then
		local base = pData._baseBrightness or v.Brightness
		pData._baseBrightness = base
		pcall(function() v.Brightness = base * (1 - amount) end)
	elseif t == "Highlight" then
		pcall(function() v.FillTransparency = amount end)
		pcall(function() v.OutlineTransparency = amount end)
	elseif t == "ImageLabel" then
		pcall(function() v.ImageTransparency = amount end)
	elseif t == "Lightning" or t == "Rocks" or t == "Rope" then
		pData._curTrans = amount
		local rig = pData._rig
		if rig then
			local n = rig.partCount or rig.chunkCap
			pcall(function()
				for i = 1, n do rig.parts[i].Transparency = amount end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Attach Skip* setters in one call. Each flips the corresponding
-- pData.Skip{Color,Transparency,Size} flag. Update branches gate per-frame writes.
-- SkipColor / SkipTransparency: Part / Beam / PointLight / ImageLabel / Screen.
-- SkipSize: Part (Update.luau) + ImageLabel (ImageEmit). Beam Width / PointLight
-- Range still write; symmetric coverage deferred.
-- SetSkipRotation NOT yet wired  -  Update.luau's rotation is interleaved with position
-- accumulation (NeedsRotAccum/VelocityVectored coupling); skipping requires deeper rework.
function EventsPayload.attachSkipSetters(payload, pData)
	payload.SetSkipColor = function(value) pData.SkipColor = value == true end
	payload.SetSkipTransparency = function(value) pData.SkipTransparency = value == true end
	payload.SetSkipSize = function(value) pData.SkipSize = value == true end
end

-- Teleport  -  write a new world CFrame to the visual + reset position-accumulator state.
-- Part / Attachment: VisualPart.CFrame = cf. Recompute LocalCF as parent's ToObjectSpace
-- of cf (or cf itself when unlinked). Resets _localWorldCF and _postUpdateCF so Orientation
-- + ZOffset overlays compose against the new pose. LastHitCheckPos resets to cf.Position so
-- the next OnHit raycast doesn't span the teleport gap and fire on a wall the particle
-- "passed through."
-- Model: VisualPart:PivotTo(cf). Same LocalCF / cache resets.
-- Beam / PointLight / ImageLabel / Screen kinds: no-op (no per-particle CFrame; PointLight
-- inherits its parent's position).
-- Wake a settled particle. Called from Teleport / AddImpulse / SetVelocity so
-- script-driven re-launch resumes natural physics with no stale settle state.
local function _clearSettleState(pData)
	pData._settleEngaged = false
	pData._restTimer = 0
	pData._settleRotDamp = 1
	pData._settleContactPos = nil
	pData._settleSpawnHalf = nil
	pData._lastHitNormal = nil
	pData._collisionStopped = false
	pData._displacementMirrorX = nil
	pData._displacementMirrorY = nil
	pData._displacementMirrorZ = nil
end

function EventsPayload.applyTeleport(pData, cf)
	if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then return end
	_clearSettleState(pData)
	local v = pData.VisualPart
	if not v or not v.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t == "Part" then
		pcall(function() v.CFrame = cf end)
	elseif t == "Attachment" then
		-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; convert world cf via parent.
		local parent = v.Parent
		if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			pcall(function() v.CFrame = parent.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf) end)
		else
			pcall(function() v.CFrame = cf end)
		end
	elseif t == "Model" then
		pcall(function() v:PivotTo(cf) end)
	else
		return
	end
	-- Recompute LocalCF in the frame the Update functions compose against (LinkCF.parentFrame /
	-- attachmentParentFrame): live, frozen or snapshot link frame, identity when never linked.
	if t == "Attachment" then
		local visualParent = v.Parent
		local parentLocalCF = visualParent and LinkCF.toParentSpace(cf, visualParent) or cf
		local linkParentCF = LinkCF.attachmentParentFrame(pData)
		pData.LocalCF = linkParentCF:ToObjectSpace(parentLocalCF)
	else
		local parentCF = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
		pData.LocalCF = parentCF:ToObjectSpace(cf)
	end
	pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF
	-- _postUpdateCF mirrors the live VisualPart.CFrame readout (init.luau:165). For
	-- Attachment that's parent-local (matches what was just written above); for
	-- Part/Model that's world. Re-read from the visual rather than re-deriving.
	if t == "Attachment" then
		pData._postUpdateCF = v.CFrame
	elseif t == "Model" then
		pData._postUpdateCF = v:GetPivot()
	else
		pData._postUpdateCF = cf
	end
	pData.CurrentPosition = cf.Position
	pData.LastHitCheckPos = cf.Position
	pData._lastOrientPos = nil -- next ApplyOrientation reseeds velocity from this frame
end

-- Add a Vector3 angular kick to pData._spinRate. EventsCollision.handleBounce
-- already populates this from `nrm × v_t`; user adds further tumble via this helper.
function EventsPayload.applyAddSpin(pData, vec)
	if typeof(vec) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	pData._spinRate = (pData._spinRate or Vector3.zero) + vec
end

-- Add a Vector3 impulse to pData._accelVel (acceleration-velocity accumulator). Update.luau's
-- per-step accel integration reads + writes _accelVel; user-added impulses persist into next step.
function EventsPayload.applyAddImpulse(pData, vec)
	if typeof(vec) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	_clearSettleState(pData)
	pData._accelVel = (pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero) + vec
end

-- Toggle pData._timeFrozen. Update branches gate effective-elapsed advance on this flag.
-- Marks `_freezeTimeExplicit` so a concurrent Pause's auto-clear doesn't undo the user's
-- indefinite freeze.
function EventsPayload.applyFreezeTime(pData, on)
	pData._timeFrozen = on == true
	pData._freezeTimeExplicit = on == true
end

-- Temporary FreezeTime: set _timeFrozen, schedule clear. Multi-call windows: a later Pause
-- bumps the gen so the earlier delay's clear is invalidated. Auto-clear respects an
-- explicit FreezeTime  -  if user has called FreezeTime(true), Pause's clear is a no-op so
-- the explicit freeze persists.
function EventsPayload.applyPause(pData, seconds)
	if type(seconds) ~= "number" or seconds <= 0 then return end
	pData._timeFrozen = true
	local gen = (pData._pauseGen or 0) + 1
	pData._pauseGen = gen
	task.delay(seconds, function()
		if pData._pauseGen == gen and not pData._freezeTimeExplicit then
			pData._timeFrozen = false
		end
	end)
end

-- Direct VisualPart.Size write + auto-flip SkipSize so per-frame Size graphs don't clobber.
-- Type-dispatch: BasePart Size (Vector3), Attachment has no Size, ImageLabel uses UDim2  -  for
-- ImageLabel pass a UDim2 instead of Vector3 (gated by typeof).
function EventsPayload.applySetSize(pData, size)
	pData.SkipSize = true
	local v = pData.VisualPart
	if not v or not v.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t == "Part" or t == "Model" then
		if typeof(size) == "Vector3" and v:IsA("BasePart") then
			pcall(function() v.Size = size end)
		elseif typeof(size) == "Vector3" and t == "Model" then
			-- Model has no Size; map to ScaleTo using x component as uniform scale.
			pcall(function() v:ScaleTo(math.max(0.001, size.X)) end)
		end
	elseif t == "ImageLabel" then
		if typeof(size) == "UDim2" then pcall(function() v.Size = size end) end
	end
end

-- Replace baseDirection (unit) + override speed magnitude. Update.luau's speed sampling
-- reads pData._speedOverride when set, bypassing authored Speed graph + speedMult. Pass nil
-- vec to clear the override and resume authored sampling.
function EventsPayload.applySetVelocity(pData, vec)
	if vec == nil then
		pData._speedOverride = nil
		return
	end
	if typeof(vec) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	_clearSettleState(pData)
	local mag = vec.Magnitude
	if mag < 1e-4 then
		pData.SpeedMultiplier = 0
		pData._speedOverride = 0
		return
	end
	pData.BaseDirection = vec / mag
	pData._speedOverride = mag
end

-- Clear _killedManually + _forceDead. Must run BEFORE next Heartbeat processes the death
-- frame, OR inside the same OnHit Module body that called Kill. After the death-frame, visual
-- is destroyed/hidden  -  too late to revive.
function EventsPayload.applyResurrect(pData)
	pData._killedManually = false
	pData._forceDead = false
end

-- Wire all advanced setters in one call. Keeps Events.luau slim (one line per attach instead
-- of seven). Caller passes the live payload + pData refs.
function EventsPayload.attachAdvancedSetters(payload, pData)
	payload.AddSpin = function(vec) EventsPayload.applyAddSpin(pData, vec) end
	payload.AddImpulse = function(vec) EventsPayload.applyAddImpulse(pData, vec) end
	payload.FreezeTime = function(on) EventsPayload.applyFreezeTime(pData, on) end
	payload.Pause = function(seconds) EventsPayload.applyPause(pData, seconds) end
	payload.SetSize = function(size) EventsPayload.applySetSize(pData, size) end
	payload.SetVelocity = function(vec) EventsPayload.applySetVelocity(pData, vec) end
	payload.Resurrect = function() EventsPayload.applyResurrect(pData) end
end

return EventsPayload

--[[
	EventsSchema  -  read/write/sanitize for the per-item Events tree.
	Tree: PartIcleProperties/Events/<EventName Configuration>/{Enabled, EmitMode, ScriptEnabled,
	ChainDepthLimit, EmitTarget (ObjectValue), Module (ModuleScript)}.
	Trail excluded (directAccess + continuous). OnHit only on Part/Attachment/Model/Lightning/Rocks.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local HitFilter = require(script.Parent.HitFilter)

local EventsSchema = {}

local EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME = "Events"
local EVENT_NAMES = { "OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction", "OnHit" }
EventsSchema.EVENT_NAMES = EVENT_NAMES
EventsSchema.EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME = EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME

local EMIT_MODES = { AtPosition = true, AtSource = true, AtTarget = true, AtCFrame = true }
EventsSchema.EMIT_MODES = EMIT_MODES

-- One line per mode for the Events UI hint under the Mode dropdown.
EventsSchema.EMIT_MODE_HINTS = {
	AtPosition = "Spawns where the event happened (emit, death or hit point).",
	AtSource = "Spawns at the source emitter's current position.",
	AtTarget = "Spawns at the target's own authored placement.",
	AtCFrame = "Spawns at the event position and rotation.",
}

-- OnHit Collision: Off (pass-through) / Kill (snap+destroy) / Stop (freeze) / Bounce (reflect).
local COLLISION_MODES = { Off = true, Kill = true, Stop = true, Bounce = true }
EventsSchema.COLLISION_MODES = COLLISION_MODES

local function clampDepthValue(v)
	local n = tonumber(v)
	if not n then return 4 end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1, 32)
end

local function safeEmitMode(v)
	if type(v) == "string" and EMIT_MODES[v] then return v end
	return "AtPosition"
end

local function safeCollisionMode(v)
	if type(v) == "string" and COLLISION_MODES[v] then return v end
	return "Off"
end

local function clampUnit(v, lo, hi, default)
	local n = tonumber(v)
	if not n then return default end
	if n < lo then return lo end
	if n > hi then return hi end
	return n
end

EventsSchema.clampChainDepth = clampDepthValue
EventsSchema.safeEmitMode = safeEmitMode
EventsSchema.safeCollisionMode = safeCollisionMode
EventsSchema.clampUnit = clampUnit

-- Per-type event validity (OnHit only on collision-bearing types).
-- OnDestruction may only be offered where Events.getWorldCF resolves an origin for the type;
-- VisualPart-less types (CameraShake, Distortion) have explicit branches there.
local VALID_PER_TYPE = {
	Part        = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = true  },
	Beam        = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	Attachment  = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = true  },
	Model       = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = true  },
	PointLight  = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	Sound       = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	Highlight   = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	TrailEmitter = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	Atmosphere  = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	Blur        = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	Bloom       = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	ColorCorrection = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	ImageLabel  = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	-- Lightning OnHit: Seek mode only — fires per strike-point acquisition
	-- (emit + each retarget) with the seek raycast's payload (Lightning/init.luau).
	Lightning   = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = true },
	CameraShake = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	-- Rocks OnHit fires ONCE per burst on first chunk contact (from the sim's own
	-- raycast, Rocks/init.luau); CollisionAction modes don't apply (physics owns bounce).
	Rocks       = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = true },
	Rope        = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
	Distortion  = { OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = false },
}

-- Per-event defaults. Enabled=false so ensureEvent paths don't implicitly arm the runtime.
local DEFAULT_ATTRS = {
	Enabled         = false,
	EmitMode        = "AtPosition",
	ScriptEnabled   = false,
	ChainDepthLimit = 4,
	Collision       = "Off",
	-- Collision physics: 0..1 each. Bounciness = normal restitution; Friction = tangential
	-- damping; Spin = nrm×v_t coefficient.
	Bounciness      = 0.7,
	Friction        = 0.2,
	Spin            = 0.5,
	-- 0 = check every Heartbeat. Clamp 0..0.5.
	HitCheckInterval = 0,
}

-- Default Module source  -  commented payload reference for the Edit Script panel.
-- Outer literal uses [==[ ... ]==] so the inner --[[ ... ]] block comment's `]]`
-- doesn't terminate the long-string early.
local DEFAULT_MODULE_SOURCE = [==[--[[
	Part-Icles event script.

	This function runs once every time this event happens to ONE particle.
	`payload` describes that particle and gives you functions to change it.
	The script only runs while the event's "Script" toggle is on. Errors show in
	the Output window and never stop the effect.
	Keep the last three lines: the file must return a function that takes `payload`.
]]

-- WHEN DOES THIS RUN?
--   OnEmit         the particle was just created
--   OnHit          the particle touched something (Part / Attachment / Model / Lightning / Rocks emitters only)
--   OnDeath        the particle's lifetime ran out, or something killed it
--   OnDestruction  the particle is removed for good (after its Linger time, if it has one)

-- QUICK EXAMPLE  (OnDeath: spawn a second effect only if the particle lived longer than a second)
--   return function(payload)
--       if payload.Age > 1 then
--           payload.Emit(workspace.Sparks, "AtPosition")
--       end
--   end

-- ============================================================================
--  THINGS YOU CAN READ  (plain values; changing them does nothing)
-- ============================================================================
--   In every event
--     payload.Source            the emitter you set up in the plugin (the original)
--     payload.Particle          the copy flying around right now (nil for Camera Shake / Distortion)
--     payload.WorldPosition     where the particle is, as a Vector3 (nil for screen effects)
--     payload.WorldCFrame       the same with rotation, as a CFrame (nil for screen effects)
--     payload.LifeTime          how many seconds the particle is set to live
--     payload.LifeProgress      0 = just born, 1 = about to die
--     payload.TimeRemaining     seconds left before it dies on its own
--     payload.StartTime         os.clock() at the moment it was created
--     payload.SpeedMultiplier   current speed scale (1 = normal; bounces lower it)
--     payload.ChainDepth        0 normally; 1, 2, ... when this particle was itself spawned by an event
--     payload.RenderTemplate    old name for payload.Particle
--
--   OnEmit only
--     payload.EmitPosition      same as WorldPosition
--     payload.EmitIndex         which particle of the burst this is (1 = first)
--     payload.EmitCount         how many particles the burst made (nil for a single emit)
--
--   OnHit only
--     payload.HitInstance       the part it touched (payload.Other is the same thing)
--     payload.HitPosition       the exact contact point (Vector3)
--     payload.HitNormal         the direction the surface faces at that point (Vector3, length 1)
--
--   OnDeath only
--     payload.DeathPosition     same as WorldPosition
--     payload.Age               how many seconds it really lived (less than LifeTime when killed early)
--
--   OnDestruction only
--     payload.DeathPosition     same as WorldPosition
--     payload.LingerElapsed     seconds spent in Linger before removal (0 without Linger)

-- ============================================================================
--  THINGS YOU CAN DO  (functions; they change this one particle only)
-- ============================================================================
--   Spawn and end
--     payload.Emit(target, mode)      fire another emitter from here. target = an emitter, a Folder or a
--                                     Model of emitters. mode = "AtPosition" | "AtSource" | "AtTarget" |
--                                     "AtCFrame"; leave it out to use this event's Mode dropdown
--     payload.Kill()                  remove the particle now (OnDeath does not fire for it)
--     payload.Resurrect()             cancel a Kill made earlier in this same script
--
--   Look
--     payload.SetColor(color3)        set the colour and stop the Color graph from changing it
--     payload.SetTransparency(0..1)   set the transparency and stop the Transparency graph
--     payload.SetSize(size)           set the size and stop the Size graph (Vector3; UDim2 for ImageLabel)
--     payload.SetSkipColor(true)      stop only the graph, keep the current value (false resumes it)
--     payload.SetSkipTransparency(true)
--     payload.SetSkipSize(true)       Parts only
--
--   Time
--     payload.SetLifetime(seconds)    new total lifetime, counted from birth (a tiny value = dies next frame)
--     payload.Pause(seconds)          freeze the particle for that long, then continue
--     payload.FreezeTime(true)        freeze until you call FreezeTime(false)
--
--   Motion
--     payload.Teleport(cframe)        move the particle there (Part / Attachment / Model only)
--     payload.SetVelocity(vector3)    fly in that direction at that speed; SetVelocity(nil) restores the authored speed
--     payload.SetSpeedMultiplier(n)   scale the speed (2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half)
--     payload.AddImpulse(vector3)     give it a push (added to its velocity)
--     payload.AddSpin(vector3)        make it tumble (spin speed per axis)

-- GOOD TO KNOW
--   * The script has its own thread: task.wait() and loops are fine, but after a wait the
--     particle may already be gone.
--   * payload.Source.Parent is nil when the emitter was deleted mid-flight; check it first.
--   * In Animate mode, payload.Particle IS the original RenderTemplate: what you change stays changed.

return function(payload)
	-- your code here
end
]==]

-- Internal: walk an item to its Events folder. Returns nil for non-config-mode types
-- (Trail) or items without the folder created yet. Doesn't create the folder.
local function getConfig(item)
	if not item then return nil end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef or typeDef.directAccess then return nil end
	return TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
end

local function getTypeName(item)
	local _, typeName = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	return typeName
end

--- Lookup the Events folder under this item's PartIcleProperties. Returns nil if the
--- folder hasn't been created yet (lazy creation). Trail / unknown types return nil.
function EventsSchema.read(item)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end
	local folder = config:FindFirstChild(EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME)
	if folder and folder:IsA("Folder") then return folder end
	return nil
end

--- Returns true if `eventName` is valid for this item's type. Used by UI to hide
--- inapplicable rows (e.g. OnHit on a Beam) and by setEnabled/ensureEvent to refuse
--- creation of disallowed events.
function EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, eventName)
	local typeName = getTypeName(item)
	if not typeName then return false end
	return EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName(typeName, eventName)
end

--- Type-name variant. UIBuilder/WidgetEvents calls this at section-build time when no
--- live item is available (the section is constructed once per type, not per selection).
--- Mirrors isValidForItem so the UI can never render rows the schema would refuse to
--- create  -  keeping a parallel local table in WidgetEvents would silently drift.
function EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName(typeName, eventName)
	local valid = VALID_PER_TYPE[typeName]
	return valid and valid[eventName] == true or false
end

--- Why `target` cannot spawn at an event origin (AtPosition / AtSource / AtCFrame), or nil when
--- it can. Single source for the runtime dispatcher (Events/EmitTarget.luau) and the Events UI
--- badge. Containers qualify when any child does.
function EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason(target)
	if not target then return "no target" end
	if target:IsA("Folder") then
		for _, child in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
			if EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason(child) == nil then return nil end
		end
		return "the folder holds nothing with a position"
	end
	if target:GetAttribute("Transformed") and (target:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") or "Emit") == "Animate" then
		return "Animate-mode targets animate their own instance"
	end
	if target:IsA("BasePart") or target:IsA("Attachment") or target:IsA("Model") or target:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		return nil
	end
	return target.ClassName .. " has no position to move"
end

function EventsSchema.emitCapability(target)
	return EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason(target) == nil
end

--- Returns the per-event Configuration child if present. Doesn't create.
function EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
	local folder = EventsSchema.read(item)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local cfg = folder:FindFirstChild(eventName)
	if cfg and cfg:IsA("Configuration") then return cfg end
	return nil
end

--- Snapshot of currently-enabled events for runtime consumption. Returns nil when no
--- event is enabled (or folder missing). Each entry is a PLAIN TABLE of captured
--- attribute values + the Module reference (only when ScriptEnabled=true)  -  NOT a live
--- Configuration ref. Snapshot semantics matter at emit time: cfg can mutate mid-flight
--- under user authoring, and a live ref would let the runtime see half-applied state.
---
--- Fail-closed on `ImportedUntrusted`: if a per-event Configuration has the attribute
--- set, runtime SKIPS it regardless of its Enabled value. Inventory / cloud import
--- pipeline stamps this attribute on imported events; the user must explicitly clear
--- it via the UI's "Trust this asset" button after reviewing the Module source.
---
--- Snapshot shape per event:
---   {
---       Enabled         = true,            -- always true (gate is at the readEnabled level)
---       EmitMode        = "AtPosition",
---       ScriptEnabled   = false,
---       ChainDepthLimit = 4,
---       EmitTarget      = <Instance|nil>,  -- ObjectValue.Value snapshot
---       Module          = <ModuleScript|nil>,  -- only when ScriptEnabled
---   }
function EventsSchema.readEnabled(item)
	local folder = EventsSchema.read(item)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local out
	for _, name in ipairs(EVENT_NAMES) do
		-- Per-type validity gate: VALID_PER_TYPE forbids OnHit on Beam / PointLight /
		-- screens / ImageLabel because they have no discrete-particle collision concept.
		-- Sanitize removes invalid configs on save / import, but a hand-edited cfg between
		-- write and the next sanitize would otherwise reach the runtime path and crash
		-- (e.g. Beam has no .CFrame, so EventsCollision.readWorldCF errors). Filter here
		-- so readEnabled and the schema agree on what's runtime-eligible.
		if not EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, name) then continue end
		local cfg = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if cfg and cfg:IsA("Configuration") and cfg:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true
			and not cfg:GetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted")
		then
			local et = cfg:FindFirstChild("EmitTarget")
			local scriptOn = cfg:GetAttribute("ScriptEnabled") == true
			local mod = scriptOn and cfg:FindFirstChild("Module") or nil
			if mod and not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then mod = nil end
			out = out or {}
			out[name] = {
				Enabled         = true,
				EventName       = name,
				EmitMode        = safeEmitMode(cfg:GetAttribute("EmitMode")),
				ScriptEnabled   = scriptOn,
				ChainDepthLimit = clampDepthValue(cfg:GetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit")),
				EmitTarget      = et and et:IsA("ObjectValue") and et.Value or nil,
				Module          = mod,
				-- Collision is OnHit-only at runtime; cheap to include for all events.
				Collision       = safeCollisionMode(cfg:GetAttribute("Collision")),
				Bounciness      = clampUnit(cfg:GetAttribute("Bounciness"), 0, 1, 0.7),
				Friction        = clampUnit(cfg:GetAttribute("Friction"), 0, 1, 0.2),
				Spin            = clampUnit(cfg:GetAttribute("Spin"), 0, 2, 0.5),
				HitCheckInterval = clampUnit(cfg:GetAttribute("HitCheckInterval"), 0, 0.5, 0),
			}
		end
	end
	return out
end

--- Lazily create the Events folder under PartIcleProperties. Returns the folder.
function EventsSchema.ensure(item)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end
	local folder = config:FindFirstChild(EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME)
	if folder and folder:IsA("Folder") then return folder end
	-- Replace if a non-Folder instance with the reserved name slipped in.
	if folder then folder:Destroy() end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME
	folder.Parent = config
	return folder
end

--- Lazily create the per-event Configuration. Stamps default attributes and the Module
--- ModuleScript with the stub source. Refuses creation when the event isn't valid for
--- the item's type. Idempotent: returns existing cfg unchanged when already created.
function EventsSchema.ensureEvent(item, eventName)
	if not EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, eventName) then return nil end
	local folder = EventsSchema.ensure(item)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local cfg = folder:FindFirstChild(eventName)
	if cfg and cfg:IsA("Configuration") then return cfg end
	if cfg then cfg:Destroy() end
	cfg = Instance.new("Configuration")
	cfg.Name = eventName
	for attrName, attrVal in pairs(DEFAULT_ATTRS) do
		cfg:SetAttribute(attrName, attrVal)
	end
	local emitTarget = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	emitTarget.Name = "EmitTarget"
	emitTarget.Value = nil
	emitTarget.Parent = cfg
	local moduleScript = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
	moduleScript.Name = "Module"
	moduleScript.Source = DEFAULT_MODULE_SOURCE
	moduleScript.Parent = cfg
	cfg.Parent = folder
	return cfg
end

--- Toggle an event's Enabled attribute. Creates the per-event Configuration on first
--- enable; toggle-off keeps the cfg + Module on disk (user code is work, don't lose it
--- because they untoggled). Returns the cfg or nil if the event isn't valid here.
function EventsSchema.setEnabled(item, eventName, enabled)
	if enabled then
		local cfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(item, eventName)
		if not cfg then return nil end
		cfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", true)
		-- setEnabled MUST NOT clear ImportedUntrusted. Otherwise the ordinary event toggle
		-- becomes an implicit trust action. Trust requires the dedicated trustEvent /
		-- trustAllEvents methods, wired from a visible "Trust Script" UI action.
		--
		-- If the user toggles an untrusted event on without trusting first, readEnabled
		-- still gates on `not ImportedUntrusted` so the runtime stays safe.
		return cfg
	end
	local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
	if not cfg then return nil end
	cfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
	return cfg
end

--- Explicit user-driven trust action. Clears ImportedUntrusted on a single event.
--- UI ("Trust Script" button on the per-event row) calls this AFTER the user has
--- reviewed the Module source in Studio's Script Editor. Doesn't touch Enabled  - 
--- enabling is a separate user action via setEnabled.
function EventsSchema.trustEvent(item, eventName)
	local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
	if not cfg then return false end
	if cfg:GetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted") then
		cfg:SetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted", nil)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--- Bulk trust action. Clears ImportedUntrusted on every event under this item.
--- UI ("Trust Asset" button on the Inventory detail panel) calls this. Caller is
--- expected to confirm with the user (modal or inline confirm) before invoking;
--- this method is the schema-side write only.
function EventsSchema.trustAllEvents(item)
	local folder = EventsSchema.read(item)
	if not folder then return false end
	local cleared = false
	for _, cfg in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if cfg:IsA("Configuration") and cfg:GetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted") then
			cfg:SetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted", nil)
			cleared = true
		end
	end
	return cleared
end

--- Stamp every event Configuration on this item with ImportedUntrusted=true and
--- Enabled=false. Called by the Inventory / cloud import pipeline after a fresh
--- DeserializeInstancesAsync call. Imported events can carry arbitrary Luau in the
--- Module ModuleScript that would execute on first event fire  -  fail-closed by
--- default so the user has to explicitly trust the asset before scripts run.
---
--- Clearing ImportedUntrusted requires the explicit trustEvent / trustAllEvents
--- methods (wired from a visible Trust Script / Trust Asset UI action). setEnabled
--- never clears the flag.
function EventsSchema.stampImportedUntrusted(item)
	local folder = EventsSchema.read(item)
	if not folder then return false end
	local stamped = false
	for _, cfg in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if cfg:IsA("Configuration") then
			cfg:SetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted", true)
			cfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
			stamped = true
		end
	end
	return stamped
end

--- Reset Event button: blow away the per-event Configuration (loses authored Module
--- source). Caller is expected to confirm with the user before invoking. Returns true
--- when something was deleted.
function EventsSchema.deleteEvent(item, eventName)
	local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
	if not cfg then return false end
	cfg:Destroy()
	-- If the Events folder is now empty, delete it too. Keeps "no events configured"
	-- distinguishable from "events configured but all disabled".
	local folder = EventsSchema.read(item)
	if folder and #folder:GetChildren() == 0 then folder:Destroy() end
	return true
end

--- Sanity-repair the Events tree on this item. Called by Migrate.fix.
---  - Drops Folder/Configuration children whose names aren't in EVENT_NAMES.
---  - Drops events that aren't valid for this item's type (e.g. OnHit on a Beam).
---  - Backfills missing default attributes on existing event Configurations.
---  - Ensures every cfg has an EmitTarget ObjectValue + Module ModuleScript child.
---  - Moves a legacy per-event CollisionGroup / ExcludeList to the type-level HitFilter.
---  - Drops any `_CompiledEventModule` clones the runtime parented for caching.
--- Returns true if any change was made.
function EventsSchema.sanitize(item)
	local folder = EventsSchema.read(item)
	if not folder then return false end
	local changed = false
	local validSet = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(EVENT_NAMES) do validSet[n] = true end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		-- Drop unrecognized siblings  -  anything not a per-event Configuration with a
		-- known event name. The compile-cache clones (named "_CompiledEventModule")
		-- live elsewhere, but if a clone leaked into the Events folder we kill it here.
		if not (child:IsA("Configuration") and validSet[child.Name]) then
			child:Destroy()
			changed = true
		elseif not EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, child.Name) then
			-- Event name is known but doesn't apply to this type (OnHit on a Beam, etc.).
			child:Destroy()
			changed = true
		else
			-- Backfill missing default attributes.
			for attrName, defaultVal in pairs(DEFAULT_ATTRS) do
				if child:GetAttribute(attrName) == nil then
					child:SetAttribute(attrName, defaultVal)
					changed = true
				end
			end
			-- Clamp ChainDepthLimit to the documented 1..32 range. Drops any non-numeric
			-- value back to the default 4  -  protects runtime apply() / readEnabled from
			-- stringly-typed garbage data on disk-imported assets.
			local depth = child:GetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit")
			local clamped = clampDepthValue(depth)
			if depth ~= clamped then
				child:SetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit", clamped)
				changed = true
			end
			-- Snap EmitMode back to AtPosition when imported assets carry an unrecognized
			-- string. Mirrors safeEmitMode in readEnabled but at sanitize time so disk
			-- state matches runtime expectations.
			local mode = child:GetAttribute("EmitMode")
			local safe = safeEmitMode(mode)
			if mode ~= safe then
				child:SetAttribute("EmitMode", safe)
				changed = true
			end
			-- Same coercion for Collision. OnHit-only at runtime; non-OnHit events keep
			-- the attribute but it's inert. Imported assets with bogus values snap to "Off".
			local cmode = child:GetAttribute("Collision")
			local csafe = safeCollisionMode(cmode)
			if cmode ~= csafe then
				child:SetAttribute("Collision", csafe)
				changed = true
			end
			-- Clamp Bounciness / Friction / Spin to safe ranges. Backfill defaults if missing.
			local physicsRows = {
				{ name = "Bounciness",       lo = 0, hi = 1,   default = 0.7 },
				{ name = "Friction",         lo = 0, hi = 1,   default = 0.2 },
				{ name = "Spin",             lo = 0, hi = 2,   default = 0.5 },
				{ name = "HitCheckInterval", lo = 0, hi = 0.5, default = 0 },
			}
			for _, row in ipairs(physicsRows) do
				local raw = child:GetAttribute(row.name)
				local clamped = clampUnit(raw, row.lo, row.hi, row.default)
				if raw ~= clamped then
					child:SetAttribute(row.name, clamped)
					changed = true
				end
			end
			if HitFilter.migrateFromEvent(item, child) then changed = true end
			-- EmitTarget ObjectValue child.
			local et = child:FindFirstChild("EmitTarget")
			if not et or not et:IsA("ObjectValue") then
				if et then et:Destroy() end
				et = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
				et.Name = "EmitTarget"
				et.Parent = child
				changed = true
			end
			-- Module ModuleScript child.
			local mod = child:FindFirstChild("Module")
			if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				if mod then mod:Destroy() end
				mod = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
				mod.Name = "Module"
				mod.Source = DEFAULT_MODULE_SOURCE
				mod.Parent = child
				changed = true
			end
			-- Drop any stray cache clones siblings of Module.
			for _, sub in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
				if sub.Name == "_CompiledEventModule" then
					sub:Destroy()
					changed = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Empty-folder cleanup.
	if #folder:GetChildren() == 0 then
		folder:Destroy()
		changed = true
	end
	return changed
end

--- Capture the current Events tree as a plain Lua table for clipboard / migration use.
--- Returns nil when no events folder exists. Snapshot omits the cache clone since it's
--- runtime-only state.
---
--- Wired by `ClipShiftFix.luau` per-event clipboard copy/paste. ImportedUntrusted is
--- preserved through the snapshot/apply round-trip: a trusted event copied from one
--- item does NOT become trusted on the paste target if the source was untrusted, and
--- an untrusted event won't silently re-trust just by skipping the flag.
---
--- EmitTargetPresent flags ObjectValue presence on the source so apply() can
--- distinguish "source had no target, clear destination" from "source field
--- absent entirely, leave destination alone".
function EventsSchema.snapshot(item)
	local folder = EventsSchema.read(item)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local snap
	for _, name in ipairs(EVENT_NAMES) do
		local cfg = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if cfg and cfg:IsA("Configuration") then
			snap = snap or {}
			local entry = {
				Enabled           = cfg:GetAttribute("Enabled"),
				EmitMode          = cfg:GetAttribute("EmitMode"),
				ScriptEnabled     = cfg:GetAttribute("ScriptEnabled"),
				ChainDepthLimit   = cfg:GetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit"),
				Collision         = cfg:GetAttribute("Collision"),
				Bounciness        = cfg:GetAttribute("Bounciness"),
				Friction          = cfg:GetAttribute("Friction"),
				Spin              = cfg:GetAttribute("Spin"),
				HitCheckInterval  = cfg:GetAttribute("HitCheckInterval"),
				ImportedUntrusted = cfg:GetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted") == true,
			}
			local et = cfg:FindFirstChild("EmitTarget")
			-- EmitTarget.Value is an Instance ref. Resolution at apply time can't restore
			-- across game-tree boundaries (clipboard between places, asset-import) so the
			-- snapshot stores the FullName for diagnostic display + the live ref for same-
			-- session paste. Apply uses the live ref when valid; FullName is fallback log.
			if et and et:IsA("ObjectValue") then
				entry.EmitTargetPresent = true
				entry.EmitTargetValue = et.Value
				entry.EmitTargetPath = et.Value and et.Value:GetFullName() or nil
			end
			local mod = cfg:FindFirstChild("Module")
			if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				entry.ModuleSource = mod.Source
			end
			snap[name] = entry
		end
	end
	return snap
end

--- Apply a snapshot back onto an item. Skips events that aren't valid for this item's
--- type (snapshotting an OnHit from a Part and pasting onto a Beam silently drops the
--- OnHit entry). Existing events on the target are NOT pre-cleared  -  existing cfgs are
--- updated in-place; missing ones are created.
function EventsSchema.apply(item, snap)
	if not snap then return false end
	local applied = false
	for name, entry in pairs(snap) do
		if EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, name) then
			local cfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(item, name)
			if cfg then
				if entry.Enabled ~= nil then cfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", entry.Enabled == true) end
				if entry.EmitMode ~= nil then cfg:SetAttribute("EmitMode", safeEmitMode(entry.EmitMode)) end
				if entry.ScriptEnabled ~= nil then cfg:SetAttribute("ScriptEnabled", entry.ScriptEnabled == true) end
				if entry.ChainDepthLimit ~= nil then
					cfg:SetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit", clampDepthValue(entry.ChainDepthLimit))
				end
				if entry.Collision ~= nil then
					cfg:SetAttribute("Collision", safeCollisionMode(entry.Collision))
				end
				if entry.Bounciness ~= nil then cfg:SetAttribute("Bounciness", clampUnit(entry.Bounciness, 0, 1, 0.7)) end
				if entry.Friction ~= nil then cfg:SetAttribute("Friction", clampUnit(entry.Friction, 0, 1, 0.2)) end
				if entry.Spin ~= nil then cfg:SetAttribute("Spin", clampUnit(entry.Spin, 0, 2, 0.5)) end
				if entry.HitCheckInterval ~= nil then cfg:SetAttribute("HitCheckInterval", clampUnit(entry.HitCheckInterval, 0, 0.5, 0)) end
				-- ImportedUntrusted round-trip: untrusted source stays untrusted, trusted
				-- source clears destination's untrusted flag. Paste of a trusted event
				-- onto a previously-imported untrusted destination unblocks the paste,
				-- because the user has now provided trusted source code by an explicit
				-- copy/paste action (clipboard is user-driven, unlike asset import).
				if entry.ImportedUntrusted == true then
					cfg:SetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted", true)
				else
					cfg:SetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted", nil)
				end
				local et = cfg:FindFirstChild("EmitTarget")
				if et and et:IsA("ObjectValue") and entry.EmitTargetPresent then
					-- Write even when EmitTargetValue is nil so paste can clear a
					-- stale destination target. Snapshot sets EmitTargetPresent
					-- whenever the source had an ObjectValue field.
					et.Value = entry.EmitTargetValue
				end
				local mod = cfg:FindFirstChild("Module")
				if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") and entry.ModuleSource ~= nil then
					mod.Source = entry.ModuleSource
				end
				applied = true
			end
		end
	end
	return applied
end

return EventsSchema

-- Flipbook  -  texture cycling for Part meshes, Beams, and ImageLabels.
-- Reads numbered Decal/Texture children from a Flipbooks folder, sorted by name.
-- frameIndex / finalFrame are the one frame clock shared with MeshFrames (mesh sequences).

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)
local MeshFlipbook = {}

-- Read + sort once at emit time, cache in data.CachedMeshTextures. Stray non-Decal/Texture children skipped.
function MeshFlipbook.GetSortedTextures(flipbookFolder: Folder): {string}
	local decalObjects = {}
	for _, child in pairs(flipbookFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then
			table.insert(decalObjects, child)
		end
	end
	if #decalObjects == 0 then return {} end

	table.sort(decalObjects, function(a, b)
		return (tonumber(a.Name) or 0) < (tonumber(b.Name) or 0)
	end)

	local textures = {}
	for _, obj in ipairs(decalObjects) do
		table.insert(textures, obj.Texture)
	end

	-- Preload textures so frame swaps are instant.
	if #textures > 0 then
		task.spawn(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(textures)
		end)
	end

	return textures
end

-- Same as GetSortedTextures but Decal-only (Beam flipbook folders).
function MeshFlipbook.GetSortedBeamTextures(flipbookFolder: Folder): {string}
	local decalObjects = {}
	for _, child in pairs(flipbookFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") then
			table.insert(decalObjects, child)
		end
	end
	if #decalObjects == 0 then return {} end

	table.sort(decalObjects, function(a, b)
		return (tonumber(a.Name) or 0) < (tonumber(b.Name) or 0)
	end)

	local textures = {}
	for _, obj in ipairs(decalObjects) do
		table.insert(textures, obj.Texture)
	end

	if #textures > 0 then
		task.spawn(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(textures)
		end)
	end

	return textures
end

-- One-time warn for SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap write fails (PluginSecurity in runtime).
local _surfaceColorMapWarned = false
local function _writeFrame(target, prop, value)
	local ok, err = pcall(function() target[prop] = value end)
	if not ok and prop == "ColorMap" and not _surfaceColorMapWarned then
		_surfaceColorMapWarned = true
		Log.warn(("[Part-Icles] SurfaceAppearance flipbook ColorMap write failed (%s). " ..
			"ColorMap is PluginSecurity  -  SurfaceAppearance flipbooks only animate in plugin context. " ..
			"For runtime games, use Decal / Texture flipbooks instead."):format(tostring(err)))
	end
end

-- SurfaceAppearance writes to ColorMap; MeshPart writes to TextureID;
-- Decal/Texture/Beam write to Texture.
local function _texProp(target)
	if target and target:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then return "ColorMap" end
	if target and target:IsA("MeshPart") then return "TextureID" end
	return "Texture"
end

-- Playback state for one target. mode: "Loop" / "PingPong" / anything else = OneShot (an
-- EnumItem is accepted). framerate clamps to 0.1 so 0 can't divide.
function MeshFlipbook.layerState(target, frames, mode, framerate, startRandom, reverse)
	if typeof(mode) == "EnumItem" then mode = mode.Name end
	if not framerate or framerate < 0.1 then framerate = 0.1 end
	local n = #frames
	return {
		target = target, frames = frames, n = n, mode = mode,
		frameDelay = 1 / framerate,
		startOffset = startRandom and math.random(0, n - 1) or 0,
		reverse = reverse == true,
		lastFrame = -1,
	}
end

-- Frame shown at `elapsed` seconds. Loop cycles at the framerate, PingPong runs forward then
-- back at the framerate, OneShot spreads the sequence once over `lifetime`. startOffset and
-- reverse apply on top.
function MeshFlipbook.frameIndex(state, elapsed, lifetime)
	local n = state.n
	local frameIndex
	if state.mode == "Loop" then
		frameIndex = (math.floor(elapsed / state.frameDelay) + state.startOffset) % n + 1
	elseif state.mode == "PingPong" and n > 1 then
		local period = 2 * n - 2
		local k = (math.floor(elapsed / state.frameDelay) + state.startOffset) % period
		if k >= n then k = period - k end
		frameIndex = k + 1
	else
		frameIndex = math.min(math.floor(elapsed / math.max(lifetime, 0.001) * n) + 1, n)
		frameIndex = (frameIndex - 1 + state.startOffset) % n + 1
	end
	if state.reverse then frameIndex = n - frameIndex + 1 end
	return frameIndex
end

-- The frame a OneShot sequence must end on.
function MeshFlipbook.finalFrame(state)
	local n = state.n
	local frameIndex = (n - 1 + state.startOffset) % n + 1
	if state.reverse then frameIndex = n - frameIndex + 1 end
	return frameIndex
end

local function _isOneShot(state)
	return state.mode ~= "Loop" and state.mode ~= "PingPong"
end

-- One task cycling `target` off pData._effectiveElapsed so Timescale, FreezeTime, Pause and
-- signed-reverse all affect playback. Wall-clock cap is the safety exit; primary teardown is
-- the Heartbeat destroying the visual. OneShot lands on its final frame before death.
local function _run(pData, particle, decals, target, lifetime, mode)
	if #decals == 0 then return end
	local framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(particle.FlipbookFramerate)
	local state = MeshFlipbook.layerState(target, decals, mode, framerate, particle.FlipbookStartRandom, particle.FlipbookReverse)
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local prop = _texProp(target)

	task.spawn(function()
		while os.clock() - startTime < lifetime * 4 do
			if not target or not target.Parent then return end
			if pData and (not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent) then break end
			local elapsed = (pData and pData._effectiveElapsed) or (os.clock() - startTime)
			local frameIndex = MeshFlipbook.frameIndex(state, elapsed, lifetime)
			if frameIndex ~= state.lastFrame then
				_writeFrame(target, prop, decals[frameIndex])
				state.lastFrame = frameIndex
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if _isOneShot(state) and target and target.Parent then
			_writeFrame(target, prop, decals[MeshFlipbook.finalFrame(state)])
		end
	end)
end

local function _playable(mode)
	return mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop or mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		or mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.PingPong
end

-- Target is Decal (Texture) or SurfaceAppearance (ColorMap); _texProp picks the slot.
-- pData is required for Timescale/FreezeTime/Pause/reverse-Timescale-aware frame indexing;
-- nil pData falls back to wall-clock elapsed for backwards compat.
function MeshFlipbook.Flip(pData, particle, decals: {string}, target, lifetime)
	if not particle or not _playable(particle.FlipbookMode) then return end
	_run(pData, particle, decals, target, lifetime, particle.FlipbookMode.Name)
end

-- Every flipbook set under a MeshFlipbooks folder: sub-folders keyed by name, numbered frames
-- directly in the folder under "" (the legacy single flipbook).
function MeshFlipbook.GetFlipbookSets(folder: Folder)
	local sets = {}
	local flat = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedTextures(folder)
	if #flat > 0 then sets[""] = flat end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			local textures = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedTextures(child)
			if #textures > 0 then sets[child.Name] = textures end
		end
	end
	return sets
end

-- One task per particle steps every layer's flipbook off pData._effectiveElapsed;
-- OneShot layers land on their final frame when the loop ends.
function MeshFlipbook.FlipLayers(pData, layers, lifetime)
	local active = {}
	for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do
		if layer.flip then table.insert(active, layer.flip) end
	end
	if #active == 0 then return end
	local startTime = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		while os.clock() - startTime < lifetime * 4 do
			if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
			local elapsed = pData._effectiveElapsed or (os.clock() - startTime)
			for i = 1, #active do
				local state = active[i]
				if state.target.Parent then
					local frameIndex = MeshFlipbook.frameIndex(state, elapsed, lifetime)
					if frameIndex ~= state.lastFrame then
						_writeFrame(state.target, "Texture", state.frames[frameIndex])
						state.lastFrame = frameIndex
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		for i = 1, #active do
			local state = active[i]
			if _isOneShot(state) and state.target.Parent then
				_writeFrame(state.target, "Texture", state.frames[MeshFlipbook.finalFrame(state)])
			end
		end
	end)
end

function MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, flipbookParticle, decals: {string}, beam, lifetime)
	if not flipbookParticle or not decals or not _playable(flipbookParticle.FlipbookMode) then return end
	_run(pData, flipbookParticle, decals, beam, lifetime, flipbookParticle.FlipbookMode.Name)
end

return MeshFlipbook

--[[
	Force Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Forces: a transformed Part or Attachment that draws nothing
	and pushes Reactor pieces while it lives.

	Each emit builds a field (Force/Fields) and lists a record in Force/Registry; the Reactor side
	reads that record. Where the field is, is a mesh particle's business: Force/Path places the
	Force by its Spawn settings, moves it by its Motion settings and keeps it on its Link, with
	the mesh's own code, and every frame the record's origin, age, front and strength are
	refreshed from it. A Force fired from inside another effect's RenderTemplate (NestedEmit) is
	linked to the emitted copy, as a nested mesh is.
	Carried by a Container, a Force runs on the Container's Timescale (pData._time, the record
	Container/Drive keeps for it): its front, its strength and its path slow with it, and its
	Registry record hands the same time to the Reactors it reaches.
	A Force's own Timescale graph does the same without a Container. It is read over the
	Force's Lifetime in real time, multiplies the Container's when there is one, and reaches
	the Reactors as a time source of the Force's own (record.ownTime, in Force/Registry's shape:
	{ timescale, play = { _released } }). When the Lifetime is over the source is released and
	the Force's clock runs normally to its end.
	An Impulse lives for its Travel Time, while its front crosses the shape, or for its Lifetime
	when it travels (it moves, or it is linked): it then kicks each piece once, as it reaches it.
	A Continuous force lives for its Lifetime.
	Either stays listed for one frame past its end, so a Reactor updated earlier in the same
	frame still reads the final front.
	Emit only: Lifecycle's Animate dispatch sends a Force here.
	The record leaves the Registry through pData._onReclaim, which every removal route runs
	(LifecycleRelease._reclaimPData); nothing else may take a Force out of ActiveEmits.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Fields = require(script.Fields)
local Registry = require(script.Registry)
local Path = require(script.Path)

-- An instant Impulse still needs a play to exist for a frame.
local SHORTEST_PLAY_SECONDS = 0.001
-- A Force that has moved this far since Reactors were last told about it is announced again.
local ANNOUNCE_AFTER_STUDS = 2

-- The Force's own Timescale this frame: its graph at the real time since the emit, over the
-- Lifetime. `carried` is the Container's timescale; the source handed to Reactors holds both.
local function ownTimescale(pData, dt, carried)
	local own = pData._ownTime
	if own.play._released then
		return 1
	end
	pData._realAge += dt
	local position = pData._realAge / pData._timeSpan
	if position >= 1 then
		own.play._released = true
		own.timescale = 1
		return 1
	end
	local scale = math.max(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(position, pData._timescaleGraph, pData._timescaleSeed), 0)
	own.timescale = scale * carried
	return scale
end

return function(Particle)

-- Force discriminator; shared by init.luau Emit dispatch + Lifecycle EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isForce(item)
	return (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment")) and item:GetAttribute("IsForce") == true
end

function Particle:UpdateForce(pData, dt, currentTime)
	if pData._finished then return true end

	local timescale = Registry.timescale(pData._time)
	if pData._ownTime then
		timescale *= ownTimescale(pData, dt, timescale)
	end
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		timescale = pData._tsOverride
	end
	local length = pData.LifeTime
	local age = pData._effectiveElapsed
	if not pData._timeFrozen then
		age = math.clamp(age + dt * timescale, 0, length)
		pData._effectiveElapsed = age
	end

	local record = pData._record
	local frame = Path.frame(pData, age / length)
	record.field.origin = Fields.orient(frame, pData._face)
	if (frame.Position - pData._announcedAt).Magnitude > ANNOUNCE_AFTER_STUDS then
		pData._announcedAt = frame.Position
		Registry.announce(record)
	end
	record.age = age
	if record.travelSpeed > 0 then
		record.front = record.travelSpeed * age
	end
	record.strength = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(age / length, pData._strengthGraph, pData._strengthSeed)

	if age >= length then
		pData._finished = true
	end
	return false
end
