function Particle:EmitForce(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data then return end

	link = Path.linkOf(data, link, emitCtx)
	local travelSpeed = Fields.frontSpeed(data.Range, data.TravelTime)
	local lifetime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	local length = Path.length(data, link, lifetime)
	length = math.max(length, SHORTEST_PLAY_SECONDS)
	local path = Path.start(self, item, data, link, emitCtx, length)

	local strengthSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Strength)
	local carried = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive or nil
	-- data.Timescale is nil for a graph flat at 1 (GetDataRig.readForce): then no source is made.
	local ownTime = nil
	local timescaleSeed = nil
	if data.Timescale then
		timescaleSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale)
		local first = math.max(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Timescale, timescaleSeed), 0)
		ownTime = { timescale = first * Registry.timescale(carried), play = { _released = false } }
	end
	local pData = {
		Type = "Force",
		VisualPart = nil,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = 1,
		CurrentStep = -1,
		LifeTime = length,
		PartLife = 0,
		Graphs = {},
		Seeds = {},
		_effectiveElapsed = 0,
		_sourceItem = item,

		-- What LinkCF reads for a mesh, so the Force sits on its link by the same rules.
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_linkLocal = path.linkLocal,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = path.rigid,

		-- From here to _finished: the play as UpdateForce reads it.
		_pathFrames = path.frames,
		_pathSteps = path.steps,
		_pathReversed = path.reversed,
		_face = data.EmissionDirection.Name,
		_strengthGraph = data.Strength,
		_strengthSeed = strengthSeed,
		_finished = false,
		_announcedAt = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
		_time = carried,
		_ownTime = ownTime,
		_timescaleGraph = data.Timescale,
		_timescaleSeed = timescaleSeed,
		_timeSpan = math.max(lifetime, SHORTEST_PLAY_SECONDS),
		_realAge = 0,
	}
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)

	-- Registered before its link is first read: _registerEmit stamps what LinkCF tells a live
	-- link from a recycled copy by (RegisterEmit.luau: _linkGen, _nestedDriven, the mask frame).
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	-- A play refused by the particle cap was reclaimed there and is not listed.
	if not table.find(self.ActiveEmits, pData) then
		return
	end

	local front = math.huge
	if travelSpeed > 0 then
		front = 0
	end
	local startFrame = Path.frame(pData, 0)
	pData._announcedAt = startFrame.Position
	local field = Fields.new(data.Shape, Fields.orient(startFrame, pData._face), data)
	-- Lift angles an Impulse's kick upward and is a Vortex's share along its axis. Any other
	-- flow goes where its shape points: a wind along the ground stays along the ground.
	if data.ActsAs == "Continuous" and data.Shape ~= "Vortex" then
		field.lift = 0
	end
	local record = {
		field = field,
		actsAs = data.ActsAs,
		strength = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Strength, strengthSeed),
		falloff = data.Falloff,
		travelSpeed = travelSpeed,
		front = front,
		age = 0,
		length = length,
		variation = data.Variation,
		turbulence = data.Turbulence,
		sizeResponse = data.SizeResponse,
		group = data.Group,
		seed = math.random(),
		time = pData._time,
		ownTime = ownTime,
	}
	pData._record = record
	pData._onReclaim = function()
		Registry.remove(record)
		if ownTime then
			ownTime.play._released = true
		end
	end
	Registry.add(record)
end

end

--[[
	Fields  -  where a Force pushes and which way. Maths on Vector3 and CFrame values only, no
	instances: Force/init builds one field per play, the Reactor side samples it.

	A field (Fields.new): shape, origin (a CFrame whose LookVector is the shape's axis), range,
	inner, halfWidth, halfHeight, height, cosHalfAngle, lift, spin, pull.
	Fields.sample(field, position, pulls) -> direction, distance, distance01, or nil outside the
	shape. `pulls` is true for a negative strength.
	  direction   which way the piece is sent: unit length, except in a Vortex, where the Spin /
	              Pull / Lift shares keep their size. A pull turns the push round but still lifts
	              upward; a Vortex is turned round whole
	  distance    how far the front travels to reach the point
	  distance01  that over the shape's reach, for the Falloff graph
]]

local Fields = {}

local UP = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local TINY = 1e-4
-- A piece up to this many studs across takes the full strength (Fields.sizeShare).
local REFERENCE_SIZE = 4
local SIZE_SHARE_MIN = 0.1
-- An Impulse's Strength is a distance; a piece in no gravity still needs a speed to be thrown at.
local LEAST_GRAVITY = 10

-- Turns that point a CFrame's LookVector along one of its own faces.
local FACE_TURN = {
	Front = CFrame.new(),
	Back = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0),
	Right = CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi / 2, 0),
	Left = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0),
	Top = CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0),
	Bottom = CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0),
}

-- The frame of a shape that points along `face` (a NormalId name) of the item's frame.
function Fields.orient(frame, face)
	return frame * (FACE_TURN[face] or FACE_TURN.Front)
end

-- settings: Range, Inner, Width, Height, Angle (degrees, full), Lift, Spin, Pull.
function Fields.new(shape, origin, settings)
	return {
		shape = shape,
		origin = origin,
		range = settings.Range,
		inner = settings.Inner,
		halfWidth = settings.Width / 2,
		halfHeight = settings.Height / 2,
		height = settings.Height,
		cosHalfAngle = math.cos(math.rad(math.clamp(settings.Angle, 0, 360)) / 2),
		lift = settings.Lift,
		spin = settings.Spin,
		pull = settings.Pull,
	}
end

-- A direction leaned toward world up by `lift`, kept at unit length.
local function lifted(direction, lift)
	if lift == 0 then
		return direction
	end
	local raised = direction + UP * lift
	local size = raised.Magnitude
	if size < TINY then
		return direction
	end
	return raised / size
end

local function sampleRadial(field, position, isCone, pulls)
	local offset = position - field.origin.Position
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	if distance > field.range or distance < field.inner then
		return nil
	end
	local direction = UP
	if distance > TINY then
		direction = offset / distance
		if isCone and direction:Dot(field.origin.LookVector) < field.cosHalfAngle then
			return nil
		end
	end
	if pulls then
		direction = -direction
	end
	return lifted(direction, field.lift), distance, distance / field.range
end

local function sampleLinear(field, position, pulls)
	local localPoint = field.origin:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local forward = -localPoint.Z
	if forward > field.range or forward < field.inner then
		return nil
	end
	if math.abs(localPoint.X) > field.halfWidth or math.abs(localPoint.Y) > field.halfHeight then
		return nil
	end
	local direction = field.origin.LookVector
	if pulls then
		direction = -direction
	end
	return lifted(direction, field.lift), forward, forward / field.range
end

-- A cylinder from the origin along the axis: around it (Spin), toward it (Pull), along it (Lift).
local function sampleVortex(field, position, pulls)
	local axis = field.origin.LookVector
	local offset = position - field.origin.Position
	local along = offset:Dot(axis)
	if along < 0 or along > field.height then
		return nil
	end
	local radial = offset - axis * along
	local distance = radial.Magnitude
	if distance > field.range or distance < field.inner then
		return nil
	end
	local outward = field.origin.RightVector
	if distance > TINY then
		outward = radial / distance
	end
	local around = axis:Cross(outward)
	local direction = around * field.spin - outward * field.pull + axis * field.lift
	if pulls then
		direction = -direction
	end
	return direction, distance, distance / field.range
end

function Fields.sample(field, position, pulls)
	if field.range <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local shape = field.shape
	if shape == "Linear" then
		return sampleLinear(field, position, pulls)
	elseif shape == "Vortex" then
		return sampleVortex(field, position, pulls)
	end
	return sampleRadial(field, position, shape == "Cone", pulls)
end

-- Studs per second a front must move to cross `range` in `travelTime` seconds; 0 for an
-- instant push (no time, or nothing to cross).
function Fields.frontSpeed(range, travelTime)
	if travelTime <= 0 or range <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return range / travelTime
end

-- The share of the Strength kept at distance01 (0 the origin, 1 the edge) for a Falloff of 0
-- to 1. A Falloff outside that range is taken as the nearest end: it never adds strength.
function Fields.kept(falloff, distance01)
	return math.max(1 - math.clamp(falloff, 0, 1) * distance01, 0)
end

-- The share of a push a piece `size` studs across takes: all of it up to the reference size,
-- less when bigger, by `response` (0 = size does not matter, 1 = twice the size takes half).
-- Never more than 1: a small piece is not thrown farther than the Force says.
function Fields.sizeShare(size, response)
	if response <= 0 or size <= 0 then
		return 1
	end
	return math.clamp((REFERENCE_SIZE / size) ^ response, SIZE_SHARE_MIN, 1)
end

-- The speed that throws a piece about `distance` studs under `gravity` (the range of a 45 degree
-- throw; with a Reactor's default Friction and a Force's default Lift a piece comes to rest within
-- a fifth of it). The sign of a pull is in the direction Fields.sample gives, not here.
function Fields.throwSpeed(distance, gravity)
	return math.sqrt(math.abs(distance) * math.max(gravity, LEAST_GRAVITY))
end

return Fields

--[[
	Path  -  where a Force is and how it moves through its life, by a mesh particle's own rules:
	the Spawn, Motion and Link settings mean for a Force exactly what they mean for a mesh.

	Nothing here works motion out. Path.start places the Force the way Emit.luau places a mesh
	(origin or link at spawn, rotation offset, position offset, direction, spread) and hands that
	to Particle:PreSimulateForward, the pre-simulation Motion Preview draws and reversed meshes
	play back; Path.frame reads that path at the play's age and sets it on the link through
	LinkCF, as LinkTrack does for a mesh every frame.

	Path.linkOf(data, link, emitCtx) -> the link the play has: the one handed to the emit (the
	copy a nested Force is fired on), else the Force's own Link; none when the emit ignores links.
	Path.start(particle, item, data, link, emitCtx, lifetime) -> { frames, steps, rigid,
	linkLocal, reversed }: the fields Force/init keeps on its pData. `link` is linkOf's answer.
	Path.frame(pData, share) -> CFrame: the Force's world frame at `share` (0 to 1) of its life.
	Path.travels(data, link) -> boolean: whether the Force goes anywhere during its life.
	Path.length(data, link, lifetime) -> seconds a play lasts, given the Lifetime drawn for it.
	Path.sketch(particle, item, data, samples) -> { CFrame }: world frames from the start of a
	play to its end, for a drawing of it (the plugin's ForceGizmo). Spawn ranges are taken at
	their middle and Spread at 0, so the drawing holds still.
	Path.hostFrame(item) -> CFrame: the item's own world frame.

	The path is worked out once, at the emit; a mesh moving forward is stepped live. A Force
	therefore does not follow two things a mesh follows during its life: a Weld or Weld Without
	Rotation link that turns while the Force travels (the whole path turns with the link), and
	an Accel toward target that moves (the path heads for where the target was). Every other
	case agrees with a mesh to a step: server/ui-test/studio/force_check.py.

	Cross-file: Path.start mirrors Emit.luau's EmitPart from its link choice to its
	PreSimulateForward call, less what only a visible part has (the Use shape volume, Orientation,
	Z-Offset, a Container's drive, a parent Model's scale). A change to how a mesh spawns is
	repeated here, as it is in the plugin's MotionPreview.buildPartSetup.
	data.Motion (GetDataRig.readForce) carries the settings under the mesh's own names.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.Parent.LinkCF)
local AxisLinks = require(script.Parent.Parent.AxisLinks)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Parent.Pool)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- Steps of the pre-simulated path per second of life, and the most a path holds.
local STEPS_PER_SECOND = 60
local MAX_STEPS = 240
-- The graphs that carry a seed of their own into the pre-simulation.
local SEEDED = { "Speed", "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ", "PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ", "AccelStrength" }
-- The graphs that make a Force travel when any of their values is not 0.
local MOVING = { "Speed", "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ", "PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ", "Turbulence" }
-- The ranges an emit draws a value from at spawn.
local SPAWN_RANGES = { "RotX", "RotY", "RotZ", "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ" }

local Path = {}

function Path.hostFrame(item)
	if item:IsA("Attachment") then
		return item.WorldCFrame
	end
	return item.CFrame
end

local function isFlat(graph)
	if typeof(graph) ~= "NumberSequence" then
		return true
	end
	for _, keypoint in ipairs(graph.Keypoints) do
		if keypoint.Value ~= 0 or keypoint.Envelope ~= 0 then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Path.linkOf(data, link, emitCtx)
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.IgnoreLink then
		return nil
	end
	return link or data.Link
end

function Path.travels(data, link)
	local motion = data.Motion
	if link then
		return true
	end
	if motion.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0 then
		return true
	end
	if motion.AccelerationTowardsInstance and motion.AccelTarget then
		return true
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(MOVING) do
		if not isFlat(motion[key]) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- An Impulse that goes nowhere is over once its front has crossed the shape; one that travels
-- or has a Timescale of its own (data.Timescale, played over the Lifetime), and any Continuous
-- force, lasts its Lifetime.
function Path.length(data, link, lifetime)
	if data.ActsAs == "Continuous" then
		return lifetime
	end
	if Path.travels(data, link) or data.Timescale then
		return math.max(lifetime, data.TravelTime)
	end
	return data.TravelTime
end

function Path.start(particle, item, data, link, emitCtx, lifetime)
	local motion = data.Motion
	local own = Path.hostFrame(item)
	local linkLocal = emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal or nil

	local spawnAxes = LinkCF.spawnAxes(motion, emitCtx)
	local unrotatedCF
	local originOverrideCF
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then
			originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver()
		end
		if not originOverrideCF then
			originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		end
	end
	if originOverrideCF then
		if emitCtx.UseFullOrigin then
			unrotatedCF = originOverrideCF
		else
			unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(originOverrideCF.Position) * own.Rotation
		end
	elseif link then
		unrotatedCF = LinkCF.spawnFrame(motion.LinkMode, link, item, own, linkLocal, emitCtx and emitCtx._sourceParentCF, spawnAxes)
	else
		unrotatedCF = own
	end
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[motion.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local rawWorldDirection = unrotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier

	local turns = AxisLinks.sampleRangeAxes(motion, motion.AxisLinks, { "RotX", "RotY", "RotZ" }, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(motion.RotOrder, turns.RotX, turns.RotY, turns.RotZ)
	local initialCF = unrotatedCF * rotXYZ
	initialCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(initialCF, motion, link, item, RangeMod, AxisLinks, emitCtx, nil, 1)

	local dirMode = motion.DirMode
	if dirMode == "Global" then
		initialCF = CFrame.new(initialCF.Position) * rotXYZ
	end
	local baseDirection
	if dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = initialCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		baseDirection = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	else
		baseDirection = rawWorldDirection
	end

	local spread = motion.ParticleData.SpreadAngle
	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)
	baseDirection = (CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection) * spreadRotation).LookVector

	local seeds = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(SEEDED) do
		seeds[key] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(motion[key])
	end
	AxisLinks.applyGraphAxisAliases(motion, seeds, motion.AxisLinks)

	motion.TotalKeyFrames = math.clamp(math.ceil(lifetime * STEPS_PER_SECOND), 1, MAX_STEPS)
	local frames, steps = particle:PreSimulateForward(motion, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, lifetime,
		MAX_STEPS, initialCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(), linkLocal, spawnAxes and own or nil)
	local parentNow = LinkCF.emitParentFrame(motion.LinkMode, link, linkLocal, spawnAxes, own)

	return {
		frames = frames,
		steps = steps,
		linkLocal = linkLocal,
		rigid = LinkCF.rigidSnapshot(motion.LinkMode, link, parentNow),
		reversed = motion.InvertMotion == true,
	}
end

-- pData carries what LinkCF reads for a mesh (Link, LinkMode, LinkAxes, _linkLocal,
-- _rigidLocalParentCF) beside the path (_pathFrames, _pathSteps, _pathReversed).
function Path.frame(pData, share)
	local steps = pData._pathSteps
	local at = math.clamp(share, 0, 1) * steps
	if pData._pathReversed then
		at = steps - at
	end
	local low = math.clamp(math.floor(at), 0, steps)
	local high = math.min(low + 1, steps)
	local frames = pData._pathFrames
	local localCF = frames[low]:Lerp(frames[high], at - low)
	return LinkCF.reapplyFrame(pData.LinkMode, (LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)), localCF)
end

function Path.sketch(particle, item, data, samples)
	local steady = table.clone(data.Motion)
	for _, key in ipairs(SPAWN_RANGES) do
		local range = steady[key]
		steady[key] = NumberRange.new((range.Min + range.Max) / 2)
	end
	steady.ParticleData = table.clone(steady.ParticleData)
	steady.ParticleData.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)

	local link = Path.linkOf(data, nil, nil)
	local lifetime = math.max(Path.length(data, link, data.Lifetime.Max), 1 / STEPS_PER_SECOND)
	local path = Path.start(particle, item, { Motion = steady }, link, nil, lifetime)
	-- A play as Force/init builds and RegisterEmit stamps it, for Path.frame to read.
	local play = {
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_sourceItem = item,
		_linkLocal = path.linkLocal,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = path.rigid,
		_pathFrames = path.frames,
		_pathSteps = path.steps,
		_pathReversed = path.reversed,
	}
	if link then
		play._linkGen = Pool.linkGen(link)
	end
	LinkCF.captureEmitFrame(play)

	local frames = {}
	for index = 0, samples do
		frames[index + 1] = Path.frame(play, index / samples)
	end
	return frames
end

return Path

--[[
	Registry  -  the Forces alive right now. Force/init lists a record when a Force is emitted,
	refreshes it every frame and takes it out when the play ends; the Reactor side reads the list
	and is told when a record arrives.

	A record, all of it written by Force/init:
	  field         a Fields table; field.origin follows the Force every frame
	  actsAs        "Impulse" or "Continuous"
	  strength      this frame's value of the Strength graph
	  falloff       how much of the strength is lost by the edge, 0 to 1 (Fields.kept)
	  travelSpeed, front     studs per second the front moves, from Travel Time; front is how
	                far it has travelled (math.huge for an instant push)
	  age, length   seconds since the emit, and the play's whole length
	  variation, turbulence, sizeResponse, group
	  seed          one number per play, for what a piece draws at random from this Force
	  time          what the Force's time runs by, or nil: the record of the Container that
	                carries it (Container/Drive: its `timescale` now, and `play`, the Container's
	                play). Force/init runs its clock by it, and so does every Reactor play of
	                which the Force moves a piece (Reactor/Play keeps it), for as long as the
	                Container's play lasts.
	  ended         true once the record has left the list

	Registry.timescale(source) -> the timescale a time source asks for now; 1 for none, and
	once its Container's play is over.
	Registry.slowest(sources) -> the slowest of a list of time sources, 1 for an empty list.
	A source that is over leaves the list.
]]

local Registry = {}

local records = {}
local listeners = {}

function Registry.add(record)
	record.ended = false
	table.insert(records, record)
	for _, listener in ipairs(listeners) do
		listener(record)
	end
end

-- Tells the listeners about a listed record again: its Force has moved, and may now reach
-- what it could not when it was emitted.
function Registry.announce(record)
	if record.ended then
		return
	end
	for _, listener in ipairs(listeners) do
		listener(record)
	end
end

function Registry.remove(record)
	record.ended = true
	local index = table.find(records, record)
	if index then
		local last = #records
		records[index] = records[last]
		records[last] = nil
	end
end

-- The live records. Read-only for callers; the order is not kept.
function Registry.list()
	return records
end

-- Calls listener(record) for every Force emitted from now on, and again whenever one is
-- announced. A listener must take a record it already knows without harm.
function Registry.onAdded(listener)
	table.insert(listeners, listener)
end

local function isOver(source)
	local play = source.play
	return play == nil or play._released == true
end

function Registry.timescale(source)
	if source == nil or isOver(source) then
		return 1
	end
	return math.max(source.timescale, 0)
end

function Registry.slowest(sources)
	local slowest = 1
	local index = 1
	while index <= #sources do
		local source = sources[index]
		if isOver(source) then
			sources[index] = sources[#sources]
			sources[#sources] = nil
		else
			slowest = math.min(slowest, math.max(source.timescale, 0))
			index += 1
		end
	end
	return slowest
end

function Registry.clear()
	for index = #records, 1, -1 do
		records[index].ended = true
		records[index] = nil
	end
end

return Registry

--[[
	GetData Mixin  -  Particle:GetData(item) reads every config attribute into a flat data table.
	Returns nil for non-transformed items.
]]

local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.EventsSchema)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local GetDataRig = require(script.Parent.GetDataRig)
local GetDataScreen = require(script.Parent.GetDataScreen)
local DragModel = require(script.Parent.DragModel)

-- Enum.X[name] throws on unknown names; pcall + default keeps emit alive on bad migrations.
local function safeEnum(enumType, name, default)
	if not name then return default end
	local ok, val = pcall(function() return enumType[name] end)
	return (ok and val) or default
end

-- Read raw <axis>LinkedTo, hand to AxisLinks.sanitize for filtering.
local function readAxisLinks(config)
	local raw = {
		SizeX = config:GetAttribute("SizeXLinkedTo"), SizeY = config:GetAttribute("SizeYLinkedTo"), SizeZ = config:GetAttribute("SizeZLinkedTo"),
		RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedXLinkedTo"), RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedYLinkedTo"), RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZLinkedTo"),
		PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetXLinkedTo"), PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetYLinkedTo"), PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZLinkedTo"),
		RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotXLinkedTo"), RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotYLinkedTo"), RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZLinkedTo"),
		PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosXLinkedTo"), PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosYLinkedTo"), PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZLinkedTo"),
	}
	return AxisLinksMod.sanitize(raw)
end

return function(Particle)

-- Resolve `item`'s authored config into a flat `data` table used by every emit /
-- update path: graphs, NumberRanges, Booleans, Link target, AxisLinks, EmitMode, etc.
function Particle:GetData(item)
	local data = {}

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
	data.EmitParent = ep and ep:IsA("ObjectValue") and ep.Value or nil

	-- LinkSource (None / Camera / Object) picks what; LinkMode (Weld / Follow / Pivot) picks how.
	local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
	local linkedInst = lk and lk:IsA("ObjectValue") and lk.Value or nil
	local linkSource = item:GetAttribute("LinkSource")
	if not linkSource then linkSource = linkedInst and "Object" or "None" end
	if linkSource == "Camera" then
		data.Link = workspace.CurrentCamera
	elseif linkSource == "Object" then
		data.Link = linkedInst
	else
		data.Link = nil
	end
	data.LinkMode = item:GetAttribute("LinkMode") or "Follow"
	data.LinkAxes = LinkCF.readAxes(item)

	data.RenderTemplate = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")

	-- Events snapshot frozen at emit; runtime fire reads only this, never live cfg.
	data.Events = EventsSchema.readEnabled(item)

	local tkf = config:GetAttribute("TotalKeyFrames") or 0
	data.TotalKeyFrames = tkf > 0 and tkf or 100

	data.CheckEnabled = function() return config.Parent ~= nil and config:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true end

	-- ROCKS / ROPE / CONTAINER / FORCE / REACTOR  -  GetDataRig.luau readers. Before the Model and
	-- Attachment branches: a Reactor may be a Model, a Container or Force an Attachment.
	local rigReader = GetDataRig.readerFor(item)
	if rigReader then
		return rigReader(data, item, config, safeEnum, readAxisLinks)
	end

	-- MODEL
	if item:IsA("Model") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or ((config:GetAttribute("VelocityVectored") and "Local") or "RigidLocal")
		data.VelocityVectored = (data.DirMode == "Local")
		data.InvertMotion = config:GetAttribute("InvertMotion") or false
		data.RotMode = config:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife"

		data.ParticleData = {

		data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
		data.Scale = config:GetAttribute("Scale")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

		data.RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
		data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
		data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true

		data.PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
		data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
		data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true
		data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
		data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"

		data.RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedX")
		data.RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedY")
		data.RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZ")

		data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
		data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
		data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
		data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
		data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

		data.Orientation = config:GetAttribute("Orientation") or "None"
		data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset") or 0

		data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		-- Gates descendant Beam's TextureLength * pFactor in UpdateBeam (parent-scale block).
		data.ScaleTextureLength = config:GetAttribute("ScaleTextureLength")
		-- Nested-particle motion scaling. ScaleMotion default true (~= false); ScaleRotation
		-- default false (== true). Carried into parentScaleInfo for nested particles to read.
		data.ScaleMotion = config:GetAttribute("ScaleMotion") ~= false
		data.ScaleRotation = config:GetAttribute("ScaleRotation") == true

		return data
	end

	-- BLUR
	if item:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.BlurSize = config:GetAttribute("BlurSize")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		return data
	end

	-- BLOOM
	if item:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.BloomIntensity = config:GetAttribute("BloomIntensity")
		data.BloomSize = config:GetAttribute("BloomSize")
		data.BloomThreshold = config:GetAttribute("BloomThreshold")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		return data
	end

	-- COLOR CORRECTION
	if item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.CCBrightness = config:GetAttribute("CCBrightness")
		data.CCContrast = config:GetAttribute("CCContrast")
		data.CCSaturation = config:GetAttribute("CCSaturation")
		data.CCTintColor = config:GetAttribute("CCTintColor")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		return data
	end

	-- ATMOSPHERE
	if item:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.AtmDensity = config:GetAttribute("AtmDensity")
		data.AtmOffset = config:GetAttribute("AtmOffset")
		data.AtmGlare = config:GetAttribute("AtmGlare")
		data.AtmHaze = config:GetAttribute("AtmHaze")
		data.AtmColor = config:GetAttribute("AtmColor")
		data.AtmDecay = config:GetAttribute("AtmDecay")
		data.AtmTimescale = config:GetAttribute("AtmTimescale")
		return data
	end

	-- IMAGE LABEL
	if item:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.ImageTransparency      = config:GetAttribute("ImageTransparency")
		data.BackgroundTransparency = config:GetAttribute("BackgroundTransparency")
		data.ImgSpeed               = config:GetAttribute("ImgSpeed")
		data.SizeScaleX             = config:GetAttribute("SizeScaleX")
		data.SizeScaleY             = config:GetAttribute("SizeScaleY")
		data.ImgRotRange            = config:GetAttribute("ImgRotRange") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.ImgRotSpeed            = config:GetAttribute("ImgRotSpeed")
		data.ImgRotMode             = config:GetAttribute("ImgRotMode") or "OverLife"
		data.ImageColor3       = config:GetAttribute("ImageColor3")
		data.BackgroundColor3  = config:GetAttribute("BackgroundColor3")
		data.Image             = config:GetAttribute("Image") or ""
		data.ImgPosition       = config:GetAttribute("Position") or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		data.ImgSizeUDim       = config:GetAttribute("ImgSize") or UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)
		data.ImgAnchorPoint    = config:GetAttribute("AnchorPoint") or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		data.ImgZIndex         = config:GetAttribute("ZIndex") or 1
		data.ImgScaleType      = safeEnum(Enum.ScaleType, config:GetAttribute("ScaleType"), Enum.ScaleType.Stretch)
		data.ImgResampleMode   = safeEnum(Enum.ResamplerMode, config:GetAttribute("ResampleMode"), Enum.ResamplerMode.Default)
		data.ImgEmissionAngle  = config:GetAttribute("EmissionAngle") or 90
		data.ImgSpreadAngle    = config:GetAttribute("ImgSpreadAngle") or 0
		data.ImgAcceleration   = config:GetAttribute("ImgAcceleration") or Vector2.new(0, 0)
		data.ImgDrag           = DragModel.rate(config, "ImgDrag")
		data.ImgInvertMotion   = config:GetAttribute("ImgInvertMotion") or false
		-- FlipbookSource: Decals folder vs Spritesheet grid.
		data.ImgFlipbookSource      = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookSource") or "Decals"
		data.ImgFlipbookMode = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookMode"), Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop)
		data.ImgFlipbookStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookStartRandom") or false
		-- Fallback values must match TypeDataScreen registry defaults.
		data.ImgGridCols            = config:GetAttribute("GridCols") or 8
		data.ImgGridRows            = config:GetAttribute("GridRows") or 1
		data.ImgFlipbookFramerate   = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookFramerate") or NumberRange.new(10)
		data.ImgFlipbookReverse     = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookReverse") or false
		-- Sheet dims stamped at edit time. Trust _SheetSize only when _SheetAsset matches current Image.
		local sSize = config:GetAttribute("_SheetSize")
		local sAsset = config:GetAttribute("_SheetAsset")
		local currentId = (type(data.Image) == "string") and (data.Image:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or data.Image:match("^(%d+)$")) or nil
		if typeof(sSize) == "Vector2" and sAsset and sAsset == currentId then data.SheetSize = sSize end
		data.ImageFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks")
		data.ImgTimescale = config:GetAttribute("ImgTimescale")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- SOUND  -  native Sound instance (GetDataScreen.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("Sound") then
		return GetDataScreen.readSound(data, config)
	end

	-- POINTLIGHT
	if item:IsA("Light") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.PLRange = config:GetAttribute("PLRange")
		data.PLBrightness = config:GetAttribute("PLBrightness")
		data.PLColor = config:GetAttribute("PLColor")
		data.PLTimescale = config:GetAttribute("PLTimescale")
		data.PLAngle = config:GetAttribute("PLAngle")
		data.PLFace = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("PLFace"), Enum.NormalId.Front)
		data.Shadows = config:GetAttribute("Shadows")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- HIGHLIGHT  -  non-spatial, attached entity. Adornee resolved as ObjectValue child
	-- (falls back to source.Parent when unset). No Link / EmissionDirection / motion.
	if item:IsA("Highlight") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.HLFillColor = config:GetAttribute("HLFillColor")
		data.HLFillTransparency = config:GetAttribute("HLFillTransparency")
		data.HLOutlineColor = config:GetAttribute("HLOutlineColor")
		data.HLOutlineTransparency = config:GetAttribute("HLOutlineTransparency")
		data.HLTimescale = config:GetAttribute("HLTimescale")
		data.HLDepthMode = safeEnum(Enum.HighlightDepthMode, config:GetAttribute("HLDepthMode"), Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop)
		local adornee = item:FindFirstChild("Adornee")
		data.Adornee = adornee and adornee:IsA("ObjectValue") and adornee.Value or nil
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- TRAILEMITTER  -  Trail with PartIcleProperties Configuration child (full particle pipeline).
	-- Discriminated from directAccess Trail by the config presence check above.
	if item:IsA("Trail") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(2)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.TEmitTimescale = config:GetAttribute("TEmitTimescale")
		data.TEmitBrightness = config:GetAttribute("TEmitBrightness")
		data.TEmitLightEmission = config:GetAttribute("TEmitLightEmission")
		data.TEmitLightInfluence = config:GetAttribute("TEmitLightInfluence")
		data.TEmitTextureLength = config:GetAttribute("TEmitTextureLength")
		data.TEmitMinLength = config:GetAttribute("TEmitMinLength")
		data.TEmitMaxLength = config:GetAttribute("TEmitMaxLength")
		data.TrailLife = config:GetAttribute("TEmitTrailLife") or NumberRange.new(2)
		-- An empty string is the dropdown's "None": no flipbook plays.
		local trailFlipbookName = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookMode")
		data.TrailFlipbookMode = if trailFlipbookName == "" then nil else safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, trailFlipbookName, Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot)
		data.TrailFlipbookFramerate = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookFramerate") or NumberRange.new(30)
		data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookStartRandom")
		data.TrailFlipbookReverse = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookReverse")
		data.TrailFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("TrailFlipbooks")
		-- Texture / TextureMode / FaceCamera live on the cloned RT directly; no Configuration mirror.
		data.GraphBlender = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- ATTACHMENT
	if item:IsA("Attachment") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or ((config:GetAttribute("VelocityVectored") and "Local") or "RigidLocal")
		data.VelocityVectored = (data.DirMode == "Local")
		data.InvertMotion = config:GetAttribute("InvertMotion") or false
		data.RotMode = config:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife"
		data.RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global"
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

		data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)

		data.ParticleData = {
			SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Drag = DragModel.rate(config, "Drag"),
		}

		data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

		data.RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
		data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
		data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true

		data.PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
		data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
		data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true
		data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
		data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"

		data.RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedX")
		data.RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedY")
		data.RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZ")

		data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
		data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
		data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
		data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
		data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

		data.Orientation = config:GetAttribute("Orientation") or "None"
		data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset") or 0

		data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")

		return data
	end

	-- CAMERA SHAKE  -  positional trauma shake (GetDataScreen.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") == true then
		return GetDataScreen.readCameraShake(data, config)
	end

	-- DISTORTION  -  screen-space glass-canvas field (GetDataScreen.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true then
		return GetDataScreen.readDistortion(data, config)
	end

	-- LIGHTNING  -  procedural part-based bolt (discriminated from Part by IsLightning attr).
	-- SpreadAngle stays FLAT on data (never inside data.ParticleData): Engine's animate
	-- replay indexes freshData.ParticleData.Acceleration unguarded  -  a partial
	-- ParticleData table would crash the Heartbeat.
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") == true then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

		data.TargetMode = config:GetAttribute("TargetMode") or "Directional"
		local targetOV = item:FindFirstChild("Target")
		data.Target = targetOV and targetOV:IsA("ObjectValue") and targetOV.Value or nil
		data.Length = config:GetAttribute("Length") or NumberRange.new(20)
		data.SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0)
		data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)

		-- Bolt-shape props are NumberRanges rolled per bolt. Coerce legacy scalar
		-- attributes (pre-range saves) so old items keep working unedited.
		local function asRange(v, default)
			if typeof(v) == "NumberRange" then return v end
			if typeof(v) == "number" then return NumberRange.new(v) end
			return default
		end
		data.GrowthSpeed = asRange(config:GetAttribute("GrowthSpeed"), NumberRange.new(0))
		data.SegmentCount = asRange(config:GetAttribute("SegmentCount"), NumberRange.new(12))
		data.Amplitude = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Amplitude"), NumberRange.new(0.15))
		data.AmplitudeDecay = asRange(config:GetAttribute("AmplitudeDecay"), NumberRange.new(0.5))

		data.ForkDepth = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ForkDepth"), NumberRange.new(0))
		data.ForkLengthScale = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ForkLengthScale"), NumberRange.new(0.4))
		data.Sag = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Sag"), NumberRange.new(0))
		data.SagShape = asRange(config:GetAttribute("SagShape"), NumberRange.new(1))
		data.SeekRadius = asRange(config:GetAttribute("SeekRadius"), NumberRange.new(30))
		data.SeekRetarget = config:GetAttribute("SeekRetarget") == true
		data.SeekBias = config:GetAttribute("SeekBias") or 0
		data.RetargetSpeed = config:GetAttribute("RetargetSpeed") or 0
		data.Gradient = config:GetAttribute("Gradient")
		data.DiskEnabled = config:GetAttribute("DiskEnabled") == true
		data.DiskMode = config:GetAttribute("DiskMode") or "Follow"
		data.DiskSize = config:GetAttribute("DiskSize")
		data.DiskTransparency = config:GetAttribute("DiskTransparency")
		data.DiskBrightness = config:GetAttribute("DiskBrightness")
		data.DiskTexture = config:GetAttribute("DiskTexture") or ""
		data.DiskOffset = config:GetAttribute("DiskOffset") or 0.05
		data.ShapeMode = config:GetAttribute("ShapeMode") or "Jitter"
		data.ScrollSpeed = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ScrollSpeed"), NumberRange.new(1))
		data.Waves = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Waves"), NumberRange.new(3))

		-- Spawn Shape (flat  -  never inside data.ParticleData; Engine replay indexes
		-- ParticleData.Acceleration unguarded).
		data.UseShape = config:GetAttribute("UseShape") == true
		data.Shape = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, config:GetAttribute("Shape"), Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box)

		data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
		data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
		data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true

		data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
		data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
		data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true
		data.RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global"
		data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or "RigidLocal"
		data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)

		-- Origin motion (flat  -  never inside data.ParticleData).
		data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
		data.Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		data.Drag = config:GetAttribute("Drag") or 0
		data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
		data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
		data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
		data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"
		data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
		data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

		data.Color = config:GetAttribute("Color")
		data.Brightness = config:GetAttribute("Brightness")
		data.Transparency = config:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		data.Thickness = config:GetAttribute("Thickness")
		data.ThicknessProfile = config:GetAttribute("ThicknessProfile")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0

	-- BEAM
	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		data.GraphBlender = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("BeamLifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

		data.BeamFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks")
		data.FlipbookParticle = {
			FlipbookMode = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, config:GetAttribute("BeamFlipbookMode"), nil),

		end

		data.FaceCamera = config:GetAttribute("FaceCamera")
		data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset")
		data.TextureMode = safeEnum(Enum.TextureMode, config:GetAttribute("BeamTextureMode"), nil)
		data.BeamProps = {
			Brightness = config:GetAttribute("BeamBrightness"),
			CurveSize0 = config:GetAttribute("CurveSize0"),

			LightEmission = config:GetAttribute("LightEmission"),
			LightInfluence = config:GetAttribute("BeamLightInfluence"),
			Segments = config:GetAttribute("Segments"),
			TextureLength = config:GetAttribute("TextureLength"),
			TextureSpeed = config:GetAttribute("TextureSpeed"),
		}
		data.BeamTimescale = config:GetAttribute("BeamTimescale")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- PART (default)
	DecalLayersMod.readInto(data, item, config)
	MeshFramesMod.readInto(data, item, config)

	data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or ((config:GetAttribute("VelocityVectored") and "Local") or "RigidLocal")
	data.VelocityVectored = (data.DirMode == "Local")
	data.InvertMotion = config:GetAttribute("InvertMotion") or false
	data.RotMode = config:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife"
	data.RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global"
	data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
	data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

	-- Target acceleration: AccelTarget readable types match getTargetPosition's dispatch
	-- (BasePart, Attachment, Camera, Model via GetPivot, Bone via TransformedWorldCFrame).
	data.AccelerationTowardsInstance = config:GetAttribute("AccelerationTowardsInstance") or false
	data.AccelStrength = config:GetAttribute("AccelStrength") or NumberSequence.new(0)
	do
		local at = item:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget")
		local picked = at and at:IsA("ObjectValue") and at.Value or nil
		if picked and (picked:IsA("BasePart") or picked:IsA("Attachment") or picked:IsA("Camera") or picked:IsA("Model") or picked:IsA("Bone")) then
			data.AccelTarget = picked
		else
			data.AccelTarget = nil
		end
	end
	-- ShapePart override (Part with UseShape=true): if set, particles sample shape volume
	-- + spawn at this BasePart's CFrame instead of the source's. nil = source fallback.
	-- A self-reference (Transform's default) is no override: keep the link-aware source frame.
	do
		local sp = item:FindFirstChild("ShapePart")
		local picked = sp and sp:IsA("ObjectValue") and sp.Value or nil
		if picked and picked:IsA("BasePart") and picked.Parent and picked ~= item then
			data.ShapePart = picked
		else
			data.ShapePart = nil
		end
	end

	data.Shape = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, config:GetAttribute("Shape"), Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box)
	data.ShapeInOut = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut, config:GetAttribute("ShapeInOut"), Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward)
	data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)
	data.UseShape = config:GetAttribute("UseShape") == true
	data.LookAtInitially = config:GetAttribute("LookAtInitially") == true

	data.ParticleData = {
		Shape = data.Shape,
		ShapeInOut = data.ShapeInOut,
		ShapePartial = math.clamp(config:GetAttribute("ShapePartial") or 0, 0, 1),
		UseShape = data.UseShape,
		LookAtInitially = data.LookAtInitially,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0),
		Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
		Drag = DragModel.rate(config, "Drag"),
		FlipbookMode = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, config:GetAttribute("FlipbookMode"), nil),
		FlipbookFramerate = config:GetAttribute("FlipbookFramerate") or nil,
		FlipbookStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("FlipbookStartRandom") or false,
		FlipbookReverse = config:GetAttribute("FlipbookReverse") or false,
	}

	data.Transparency = config:GetAttribute("Transparency")
	data.Color = config:GetAttribute("Color")
	data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
	data.Brightness = config:GetAttribute("Brightness")
	data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

	data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)

	data.SizeX = config:GetAttribute("SizeX")
	data.SizeY = config:GetAttribute("SizeY")
	data.SizeZ = config:GetAttribute("SizeZ")

	data.RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotX") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
	data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
	data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true

	data.PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosX") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosY") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
	data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
	data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true
	data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
	data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"

	data.RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedX")
	data.RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedY")
	data.RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZ")

	data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
	data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
	data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
	data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
	data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

	data.Orientation = config:GetAttribute("Orientation") or "None"
	data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset") or 0

	data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")

	return data
end

local GetDataRig = {}

-- Coerce legacy scalar attributes so pre-range saves keep working unedited.
local function asRange(v, default)
	if typeof(v) == "NumberRange" then return v end
	if typeof(v) == "number" then return NumberRange.new(v) end
	return default
end

-- Container: Mode, the play's length and the Drive graphs (TypeDataContainer).
function GetDataRig.readContainer(data, item, config)
	data.Lifetime = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Lifetime"), NumberRange.new(1))
	data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 2
	data.Mode = config:GetAttribute("Mode") or "Absolute"
	data.DriveColor = config:GetAttribute("DriveColor")
	data.ColorMode = config:GetAttribute("ColorMode") or "Recolor"
	data.DriveGraphs = {}
	for key in pairs(DRIVE_GRAPHS) do
		local graph = config:GetAttribute(key)
		if typeof(graph) == "NumberSequence" then
			data.DriveGraphs[key] = graph
		end
	end
	-- kind -> { [drive key] = true } for what a row's asterisk keeps that kind out of.
	data.DriveSkips = {}
	for _, kind in ipairs(APPLY_KINDS) do
		data.DriveSkips[kind] = {}
	end
	for row, keys in pairs(SKIP_ROWS) do
		local skipped = config:GetAttribute(row .. "Skip")
		if type(skipped) == "string" then
			for kind in string.gmatch(skipped, "[^,%s]+") do
				local skips = data.DriveSkips[kind]
				if skips then
					for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
						skips[key] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return data
end

-- A Force's Spawn and Motion settings under the mesh's field names, as Emit.luau's spawn steps
-- and Particle:PreSimulateForward read them (through Force/Path). On the config MoveDirection
-- is the mesh's EmissionDirection and MotionTurbulence its Turbulence: a Force keeps its shape's
-- facing and its gusts under those two names. A missing attribute reads as its default.
local MOTION_GRAPHS = { "Speed", "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ", "PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ", "AccelStrength" }
local MOTION_RANGES = { "RotX", "RotY", "RotZ", "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ" }
local EVEN_FLAGS = { "RotXEven", "RotYEven", "RotZEven", "PosXEven", "PosYEven", "PosZEven" }
local NO_GRAPH = NumberSequence.new(0)
local NO_RANGE = NumberRange.new(0)

local function graphOf(value)
	if typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
		return value
	end
	return NO_GRAPH
end

local function readForceMotion(data, item, config, safeEnum, readAxisLinks)
	local motion = {
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or "RigidLocal",
		InvertMotion = config:GetAttribute("InvertMotion") == true,
		RotMode = config:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global",
		PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local",
		DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global",
		EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("MoveDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Front),
		Turbulence = graphOf(config:GetAttribute("MotionTurbulence")),
		TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1,
		AccelerationTowardsInstance = config:GetAttribute("AccelerationTowardsInstance") == true,
		AxisLinks = readAxisLinks and readAxisLinks(config) or {},
		ParticleData = {
			SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Drag = DragModel.rate(config, "Drag"),
		},
	}
	motion.VelocityVectored = motion.DirMode == "Local"
	for _, key in ipairs(MOTION_GRAPHS) do
		motion[key] = graphOf(config:GetAttribute(key))
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(MOTION_RANGES) do
		local range = config:GetAttribute(key)
		if typeof(range) ~= "NumberRange" then
			range = NO_RANGE
		end
		motion[key] = range
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(EVEN_FLAGS) do
		motion[key] = config:GetAttribute(key) == true
	end
	local target = item:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget")
	local picked = target and target:IsA("ObjectValue") and target.Value or nil
	if picked and (picked:IsA("BasePart") or picked:IsA("Attachment") or picked:IsA("Camera") or picked:IsA("Model") or picked:IsA("Bone")) then
		motion.AccelTarget = picked
	end
	return motion
end

-- A Force's own Timescale graph, or nil when it is flat at 1: Force/init and Force/Path take
-- nil as "no Timescale", and such a Force plays exactly as one made before the property.
local function authoredTimescale(sequence)
	if typeof(sequence) ~= "NumberSequence" then
		return nil
	end
	for _, keypoint in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		if keypoint.Value ~= 1 or keypoint.Envelope ~= 0 then
			return sequence
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Force: every property flat on data, a missing attribute as TypeDataForce's default.
local FORCE_NUMBERS = { "Range", "Inner", "Width", "Height", "Angle", "Falloff", "TravelTime", "Lift", "Spin", "Pull", "Variation", "Turbulence", "SizeResponse", "Rate" }
function GetDataRig.readForce(data, item, config, safeEnum, readAxisLinks)
	for _, key in ipairs(FORCE_NUMBERS) do
		local value = config:GetAttribute(key)
		if type(value) ~= "number" then
			value = FORCE_PROPERTIES[key].default
		end
		data[key] = value
	end
	local strength = config:GetAttribute("Strength")
	if typeof(strength) ~= "NumberSequence" then
		strength = FORCE_PROPERTIES.Strength.default
	end
	data.Strength = strength
	data.Timescale = authoredTimescale(config:GetAttribute("Timescale"))
	data.Lifetime = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Lifetime"), FORCE_PROPERTIES.Lifetime.default)
	data.Shape = config:GetAttribute("Shape") or FORCE_PROPERTIES.Shape.default
	data.ActsAs = config:GetAttribute("ActsAs") or FORCE_PROPERTIES.ActsAs.default
	data.Group = config:GetAttribute("Group") or ""
	data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Front)
	data.Motion = readForceMotion(data, item, config, safeEnum, readAxisLinks)
	-- Lifecycle's Enable loop reads the even flags from data itself, for its even spread.
	for _, key in ipairs(EVEN_FLAGS) do
		data[key] = data.Motion[key]
	end
	return data
end

-- Reactor: every property flat on data, a missing attribute as TypeDataReactor's default.
function GetDataRig.readReactor(data, item, config)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Hold", "HoldSpread", "PieceSize", "Pieces", "AfterDelay", "AfterTime", "MaxPieces", "MaxAirTime" }) do
		local value = config:GetAttribute(key)
		if type(value) ~= "number" then
			value = REACTOR_PROPERTIES[key].default
		end
		data[key] = value
	end
	data.Break = config:GetAttribute("Break") or REACTOR_PROPERTIES.Break.default
	data.ShardPattern = config:GetAttribute("ShardPattern") or REACTOR_PROPERTIES.ShardPattern.default
	data.Collapse = config:GetAttribute("Collapse") ~= false
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Gravity", "Bounciness", "Friction", "TumbleSpeed" }) do
		data[key] = asRange(config:GetAttribute(key), REACTOR_PROPERTIES[key].default)
	end
	data.After = config:GetAttribute("After") or REACTOR_PROPERTIES.After.default
	data.Group = config:GetAttribute("Group") or ""
	return data
end

-- The reader of a rig type, Container, Force or Reactor, or nil for every other item. readAxisLinks is
-- GetData's own; Rope stores axis links.
function GetDataRig.readerFor(item)
	if item:GetAttribute("IsContainer") == true then
		return GetDataRig.readContainer
	end
	if item:GetAttribute("IsForce") == true then
		return GetDataRig.readForce
	end
	if item:GetAttribute("IsReactor") == true then
		return GetDataRig.readReactor
	end
	if not item:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end
	if item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") == true then
		return GetDataRig.readRocks
	end
	if item:GetAttribute("IsRope") == true then
		return function(data, rope, config, safeEnum, readAxisLinks)
			data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)
			return GetDataRig.readRope(data, rope, config, safeEnum)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

return GetDataRig

-- Graph  -  sampling primitives for NumberSequence + ColorSequence graphs.
-- Seed shape: {[keypointIndex] = number}. Single intensity per seed correlates drift
-- across keypoints (adjacent points drift together instead of jittering independently).

local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a end if x > b then return b end return x end
local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end

local Graph = {}

-- Roll a fresh envelope seed; each keypoint gets ±intensity*Envelope (one intensity, one sign).
function Graph.GenerateSeed(graph: NumberSequence?)
	local seed = {}
	-- Legacy items can lack newly-added graphs; empty seed → QueryPointsWithTime falls through.
	if not graph or typeof(graph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seed end
	local kp = graph.Keypoints
	local intensity = math.random()
	local isPositive = math.random() >= 0.5
	for i = 1, #kp do
		if kp[i].Envelope > 0 then
			if isPositive then
				seed[i] = intensity * kp[i].Envelope
			else
				seed[i] = -intensity * kp[i].Envelope
			end
		end
	end
	return seed
end

function Graph.GenerateSeeds(graph: NumberSequence, NoOfSeeds: number)
	local seeds = {}
	for i = 1, NoOfSeeds do
		seeds[i] = Graph.GenerateSeed(graph)
	end
	return seeds
end

-- Sample a NumberSequence at t∈[0,1] with optional envelope seed.
function Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t: number, graph: NumberSequence, seed: {number})
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local keypoints = graph.Keypoints
	local n = #keypoints

	if n == 1 then return keypoints[1].Value + (seed[1] or 0) end

	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while lo < hi - 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if keypoints[mid].Time <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local k1 = keypoints[lo]
	local k2 = keypoints[lo + 1]
	local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
	local point = span > 0 and (t - k1.Time) / span or 0
	local k1value = k1.Value + (seed[lo] or 0)
	local k2value = k2.Value + (seed[lo + 1] or 0)
	return k1value + ((k2value - k1value) * point)
end

-- Sample a ColorSequence at t∈[0,1]. ColorSequences have no envelope, so no seed.
function Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t: number, graph: ColorSequence)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local kp = graph.Keypoints
	local n = #kp
	if n == 0 then return Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
	if n == 1 then return kp[1].Value end
	if t <= kp[1].Time then return kp[1].Value end

	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while lo < hi - 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if kp[mid].Time <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local k1 = kp[lo]
	local k2 = kp[lo + 1]
	local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
	local point = span > 0 and (t - k1.Time) / span or 0
	return k1.Value:Lerp(k2.Value, point)
end

-- Trapezoidal integral of a NumberSequence over [0, t]. Used by TextureSpeed.
function Graph.IntegrateUpTo(t: number, sequence: NumberSequence, seed: {number}): number
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local keypoints = sequence.Keypoints
	local n = #keypoints
	if n == 0 then return 0 end
	if n == 1 then return (keypoints[1].Value + (seed[1] or 0)) * t end

	local total = 0
	for i = 1, n - 1 do
		local k1 = keypoints[i]
		local k2 = keypoints[i + 1]
		if t <= k1.Time then break end

		local v1 = k1.Value + (seed[i] or 0)
		local v2 = k2.Value + (seed[i + 1] or 0)
		local segEnd = math.min(t, k2.Time)
		local segLength = segEnd - k1.Time
		local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
		local alpha = span > 0 and (segEnd - k1.Time) / span or 0
		local vEnd = v1 + (v2 - v1) * alpha

		total = total + (v1 + vEnd) / 2 * segLength
		if t <= k2.Time then break end
	end
	return total
end

-- True if the sequence produces a constant value (single keypoint zero-envelope or all-equal).
function Graph.IsStatic(sequence: NumberSequence): boolean
	if not sequence then return true end
	local kps = sequence.Keypoints
	-- Non-zero envelope → per-particle randomness, so not static.
	if #kps == 1 then return kps[1].Envelope == 0 end
	local val = kps[1].Value
	if kps[1].Envelope ~= 0 then return false end
	for i = 2, #kps do
		if kps[i].Value ~= val or kps[i].Envelope ~= 0 then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Graph.GetStaticValue(sequence: NumberSequence, defaultValue: number): number
	if not sequence or #sequence.Keypoints == 0 then
		return defaultValue
	end
	return sequence.Keypoints[1].Value
end

-- Merge unique sorted times from two NumberSequence or ColorSequence (both expose Keypoints[].Time).
local function _mergeSequenceTimes(seqA, seqB)
	local times = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, seq in ipairs({seqA, seqB}) do
		for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
			if not seen[kp.Time] then
				seen[kp.Time] = true
				table.insert(times, kp.Time)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(times)
	return times
end

function Graph.BlendGraphWithTime(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, SpeedGraph: NumberSequence, alpha: number)
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 1, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local blendFactor = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(alpha, SpeedGraph, {})

	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, blendFactor)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.BlendColorGraphWithTime(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, SpeedGraph: NumberSequence, alpha: number)
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 1, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local blendFactor = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(alpha, SpeedGraph, {})

	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, blendFactor)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Linear blend between two NumberSequences at alpha (no speed graph). Beam graph blender.
function Graph.LerpGraph(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, alpha: number): NumberSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, alpha)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.LerpColorGraph(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, alpha: number): ColorSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Cache merged times once at emit time so per-frame LerpGraphFast skips the merge.
function Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence): {number}
	return _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
end

function Graph.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence): {number}
	return _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
end

-- Endpoint short-circuit: alpha 0/1 returns the source sequence to skip per-frame allocation.
function Graph.LerpGraphFast(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, alpha: number, mergedTimes: {number}): NumberSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	if alpha == 0 then return GraphA end
	if alpha == 1 then return GraphB end
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(mergedTimes) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, alpha)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.LerpColorGraphFast(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, alpha: number, mergedTimes: {number}): ColorSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	if alpha == 0 then return GraphA end
	if alpha == 1 then return GraphB end
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(mergedTimes) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Collect Beam GraphBlender states from Configuration children (Time/Transparency/Color attrs).
-- A state's optional Transition graph eases the blend INTO it (x = linear segment alpha).
function Graph.CollectGraphStates(graphBlender)
	local transStates, colorStates = {}, {}
	if not graphBlender then return transStates, colorStates end

	for _, child in pairs(graphBlender:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("Configuration") then continue end
		local time = child:GetAttribute("Time")
		if time == nil then
			local num = tonumber(string.match(child.Name, "%d+"))
			time = num and (num - 1) or 0
		end
		local transition = child:GetAttribute("Transition")
		if typeof(transition) ~= "NumberSequence" then transition = nil end
		local trans = child:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		if trans and typeof(trans) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(transStates, {Time = time, Graph = trans, Transition = transition})
		end
		local color = child:GetAttribute("Color")
		if color and typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then
			table.insert(colorStates, {Time = time, Graph = color, Transition = transition})
		end
	end

	table.sort(transStates, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	table.sort(colorStates, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	-- Normalize fallback values into 0-1 range.
	for _, states in ipairs({transStates, colorStates}) do
		if #states > 1 and states[#states].Time > 1 then
			local maxTime = states[#states].Time
			if maxTime > 0 then for _, s in ipairs(states) do s.Time = s.Time / maxTime end end
		end
	end

	return transStates, colorStates
end

-- Initial _effectiveElapsed for a particle whose Timescale starts negative.
-- ts(0) < 0 → start at end of life (i=1), rewind to 0; otherwise start at 0.
function Graph.InitialEffectiveElapsed(graph, seed, lifeTime)
	if not graph or typeof(graph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return 0 end
	-- Empty seed fallback: i=0 is deterministic on the first keypoint regardless of envelope.
	local ts0 = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graph, seed or {})
	return (ts0 < 0) and lifeTime or 0
end

-- Scale a NumberSequence: values *= factor, envelopes *= abs(factor).
function Graph.ScaleSequence(seq, factor)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seq end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints
	local new = {}
	local absFactor = math.abs(factor)
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value * factor, kp.Envelope * absFactor))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end

return Graph
